title: Finance Admin Assistant (Remote)
description:
Job Description

The Finance Admin Assistant is dedicated to keeping Intelligent Technical Solutions compliant and ensuring finance administration runs smoothly. This position is key in supporting multi-state sales tax, commission processing, accounts payable, business licenses, entity filings, insurance, and lease records. Because the work is compliance-based, this role requires accuracy in every filing, payment, and record, while new sales tax nexus obligations call for careful, independent research. The ideal candidate is a highly motivated, detail-oriented self-starter who takes initiative, holds themselves to a high standard, and is always looking for a better way to get the work done.



Job Responsibilities

Prepare, file and pay sales tax returns across multiple states and local jurisdictions (including IL, MI, NV, WA, AZ, FL, TX, CA and San Francisco) accurately and on time

Research nexus, registration, rates and product taxability when the company reaches a new sales tax nexus, and set up tax codes for clients in ConnectWise

Support use tax, B&O tax and personal property tax compliance, including assessments and payments

Process monthly commissions for Client Success, Outside Sales, employees, third parties and channel partners, including QuoteWerks MRR/NRR conversions and paid invoice data pulls

Support accounts payable processing in Sage Intacct, including bill entry, vendor setup and refunds

Maintain business license and permit registrations and renewals, and prepare business filings and entity documentation through the CSC portal

Track leases, utilities, insurance policies and certificate of insurance (COI) requests, and monitor renewal and 90-day notice deadlines

Work the Finance Admin service board, triaging and resolving tickets within agreed turnaround times

Keep trackers, the filing calendar and the Finance Admin Reference Guide accurate and up to date

Find work without being assigned it, and suggest or build improvements to Finance Admin processes



Job Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field preferred

1-2 year of accounting, tax or compliance experience required; US sales tax experience preferred

Strong attention to detail and a high personal standard for accuracy, since the work is compliance based

Strong research skills, with the ability to find, read and apply state tax rules and official guidance on your own

Highly motivated self-starter who finds work without being told and looks for ways to improve processes

Strong Excel skills (lookups, pivot tables, reconciliations)

Clear written and verbal English communication skills

Reliable high-speed internet required

Dual-monitor workstation preferred

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with US multi-state sales tax filing or nexus research

Background in a managed services provider (MSP) or IT services company

Experience using AI tools to speed up research and documentation

Tools & Technology Used

Sage Intacct

ConnectWise Manage

QuoteWerks

US Based State and local tax department portals

Microsoft 365, including advanced Excel



Job Requirements

A home office set up that meets the following:

Computer: A working computer with a minimum of 8GB RAM and one of the following:

Windows 11 with an Intel i5 or i7 (8th generation or newer), or

AMD Ryzen 5 or 7 (2000 series or newer), or

macOS 12 or newer.

Internet: Stable internet connection with at least 25 Mbps download and upload speeds.

Audio Equipment: A quality headset with a noise-cancellation feature for meetings.

Mobile Device: A smartphone capable of installing the Microsoft Authenticator app.

Webcam: An HD webcam for video calls.

2nd Monitor 

UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) if using a desktop (Not needed if using a laptop)

A very strong cultural fit the ITS way (Our core values will be discussed during the interview) 

Excellent command of the English language both spoken and written 

Able to work full time for 40 hrs. a week:  8:00 AM to 5:00 PM PST (Monday to Friday)

Able to pass our online behavior and cognitive assessments. 

Preferably, at least two of the following certifications: CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, 3cx Basic Certified Engineer.

Able to provide NBI Clearance (for PH applicants).



Compensation

Pay rate starts at Php 43,000/month and may vary by experience and location.

title: Full-Time Outreach & Lead Generation Specialist
description:
Hiring: Full-Time Outreach & Lead Generation Specialist (Remote)



Pay: $6–$9 USD/hour + performance bonuses

Hours: 40 hours/week



About Us



Grow Your Practice is a U.S.-based business that helps solo and small-firm lawyers attract more clients, increase revenue, and grow their practices.



I'm looking for an experienced, highly reliable, and resourceful person to help grow the business through personalized outreach and follow-up.



What You'll Do



Research and identify solo and small-firm lawyers who may benefit from our services.



Conduct personalized, one-to-one outreach through LinkedIn and
.



Start natural conversations, respond to inquiries, and follow up with prospects.



Schedule qualified appointments on my calendar.



Manage contacts, follow-ups, and pipelines in GoHighLevel (GHL).



Help with occasional administrative, research, and marketing tasks.



Track outreach activity and results.



What I'm Looking For



At least 2 years of experience in lead generation, direct outreach, or appointment setting.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Experience using LinkedIn,
 outreach, and CRM software (GHL preferred).



Comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools.



Organized, resourceful, and able to work independently without constant supervision.



Strong attention to detail and good judgment.



Experience working with U.S. businesses is preferred.



Reliability and punctuality are absolutely essential. I need someone who consistently shows up on time, meets deadlines, communicates proactively, and can be counted on every single workday. You must have a dependable internet connection, a reliable computer, and a backup plan for power or internet interruptions. Occasional genuine emergencies are understandable, but recurring absences, last-minute cancellations, and unreliable availability will not work for this position.



Important: I'm not looking for someone to send hundreds of generic messages. I want someone who can research prospects, personalize outreach, and build genuine professional conversations.



How to Apply



To demonstrate that you've read this entire job posting and can follow instructions, please use exactly 31 Apply Points when applying.



Answer all the following questions. Applications that don't follow these instructions or fail to answer the questions will not be considered.



1) Experience: How many years of direct outreach or appointment-setting experience do you have? Briefly describe the businesses you've worked with.



2) Results: Describe one outreach campaign you personally managed. How many prospects did you contact, what approach did you use, and how many appointments or clients resulted?



3) Writing Sample: Imagine you're reaching out to a solo attorney on LinkedIn who has never heard of Grow Your Practice. Write the actual first message you would send to start a conversation.



4) Tools: Which CRM platforms and outreach tools have you used? Describe your experience with GoHighLevel, if any.



5) Reliability: Describe your home office setup, internet connection, and backup arrangements for power or internet outages. Can you commit to a consistent full-time schedule?



6) Availability & Pay: What is your expected hourly rate, when can you start, and can you work full-time with some overlap during U.S. business hours?



Please also include your résumé and OnlineJobs.ph profile link.



I'm looking for a dependable, long-term team member who takes ownership of their work, communicates clearly, and delivers results without needing constant supervision.

description:
Finance and Payroll Officer (Part-time)



Hours: Part-time, around 20 hours a week, on fixed days. Remote, with some overlap with Melbourne time (AEST).



About us

Castillo Marketing is a marketing agency that works only with painting businesses. We run paid ads, funnels and video for painters across Australia. We are growing quickly and need a careful, reliable person to look after our billing, payment preparation and cash forecast.



What you will do



- Chase overdue invoices politely and on a set schedule, and keep our billing record up to date.



- Match payments to invoices, and flag anything that does not add up.



- Prepare our pay runs and calculate commission. You prepare the work, and the CEO approves and releases every payment.



- Update our cash forecast every week and send a short monthly summary.



- Send our accountant the information they need at month end.



What we are looking for



- Experience in payroll preparation, collections or accounts receivable.



- Xero experience.



- You have built or maintained a cash forecast.



- Very high attention to detail. You report your own mistakes immediately.



- Clear, formal written English for client messages.



- Trustworthy with confidential pay and client information.

title: Senior Graphic Designer (Full-Time | Canva + Adobe + AI Workflow | Hands-On Senior Role)
description:
JOB TITLE: Senior Graphic Designer (Full-Time | Canva + Adobe + AI Workflow | Hands-On Senior Role)



SHIFT: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday - Friday (8:00 PM - 4:00 AM PHT or 9:00 PM - 5:00 AM PHT depending on Daylight Saving Time). Note: The 8:00 AM Eastern clock-in is strict.

HOURS: 40 Hours per Week (Full-Time, Long-Term)

COMPENSATION: $700 USD per Month (Bi-weekly or monthly direct payout, no unpaid test work required to apply)



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ABOUT THE ROLE & OUR CULTURE

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We are a US-based digital marketing agency looking for an experienced, highly adaptable Senior Graphic Designer to take full ownership of our visual creative execution across both digital and print.



In this role, you will set the visual bar for our accounts, ensure uncompromising brand consistency, catch technical errors before clients ever see them, and personally produce polished assets for our clients.



No Creepy Surveillance: We believe in professional autonomy. We do not use time-tracking screenshots, keyloggers, or webcam monitoring. Our culture runs on trust, clear deliverables, and milestone accountability. In exchange for that independence, we demand strict punctuality at our 8:00 AM Eastern start, fast responsiveness on chat during your shift, and total ownership over deadlines.



CRITICAL: STRICTLY INDIVIDUAL FREELANCERS ONLY

Do not apply if you run an agency, subcontract tasks, or employ other people to do your work. We are hiring one dedicated, full-time team member. You will personally join daily English voice or video calls, participate in live design reviews, and execute the actual creative deliverables yourself.



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WHAT YOU WILL DO

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

- High-Standard Hands-On Design (70%): Execute polished, conversion-focused digital assets (social campaigns, paid ads, presentation decks, marketing collateral) and production-ready print materials (menus, brochures, flyers, large-format banners).

- Prepress & Technical File Preparation: Take complete ownership of production files. Ensure correct CMYK color spaces, bleed margins, vector scaling, and font licensing before anything goes to print or live deployment.

- Brand Consistency & Quality Control (15%): Audit graphics across agency accounts, spot alignment or typographic errors before client delivery, and establish reusable design systems that keep client assets consistent.

- AI-Driven Workflows: Integrate modern AI tools into daily production. Use Claude (Claude Design) for building brand guides and rapid web layout prototyping, along with ChatGPT and Gemini for visual ideation, concept testing, and mood boarding before finalizing assets in Adobe or Canva.

- Tool Agility: Rely on Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for complex photo manipulation, vector illustration, and prepress work, while happily using Canva for rapid asset iteration, team templates, and fast client handoffs.

- Technical & Web Collaboration (15%): Assist with visual and layout prep for landing pages, web graphics, and CMS platforms (working knowledge of WordPress, Elementor, or Figma layout principles is a major asset).



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

title: Loan Processor
description:
Loan Processor Job Description



• Conduct detailed serviceability checks to confirm applicants can meet repayment obligations, using relevant calculators and tools.

• Check loan scenarios against individual lender credit policies to confirm eligibility and identify potential issues before proceeding.

• Research and compare suitable lender products, interest rates, and policies to identify the best-fit options for each client's circumstances.

mbers to resolve any issues arising during assessment or processing.

Someone who doesn't just talk about great advertising — **they have proof they've created it.**

title: Outreach Coordinator — Creator & Community Outreach
description:
Company: MailDay  

Type: Part-time, deliverable-based  

Compensation: $350 USD/month + performance bonuses  

Schedule: Flexible, Monday–Friday deliverables  

Growth Opportunity: Partnerships & Business Development



About MailDay



MailDay is a U.S.-based children's pen-pal membership for ages 4–12. We match kids with real pen pals, send monthly story-driven letter missions, and bring back the excitement of sending and receiving real mail.



Website: 



We're a small, founder-led business looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Outreach Coordinator to help introduce MailDay to more families.



Our immediate priority is simple: get MailDay in front of more of the right people.



We already have AI prospecting systems, outreach templates, and an organized CRM. We need someone who can take those resources and consistently turn them into thoughtful, personalized outreach.



This is not a general virtual assistant position. We're looking for someone who writes well, pays attention to details, and can work independently without needing constant direction.



Pay



$350 USD per month, paid monthly.



Plus a company growth bonus:



- $150 bonus in any calendar month MailDay gains 20–39 new paying members.

- $300 bonus in any calendar month MailDay gains 40 or more new paying members.



Bonuses are based on MailDay's total new paying memberships, not individual
 attribution. Bonuses are not cumulative.



This is a deliverable-based role, not an hourly position. You're responsible for completing the agreed-upon work, not logging a certain number of hours.



You choose when to work, provided the work is completed consistently, deadlines are met, and communication is reliable.



If you finish your day's work in two hours, your day is done.



We anticipate approximately 15–20 hours per week, depending on your experience and efficiency.



What You'll Deliver:



Every Working Day (Monday–Friday)



1. Homeschool Co-op Outreach



- Send 20 personalized outreach
s to homeschool co-ops and relevant organizations.

- Use our approved outreach templates, adapting each message to the specific recipient.

- Verify contact information and relevant details before sending.

- Accurately log all outreach in ClickUp.



2. Creator Outreach



- Prepare 20 personalized outreach messages for homeschool, parenting, and family-focused content creators.

- Review each creator's content and identify a genuine, specific personalization opportunity.

- Adapt our approved templates to sound natural and relevant.

- Prepare messages for founder sending or send through approved channels when authorized.



3. Replies & Follow-Ups



- Check incoming outreach replies.

- Complete all scheduled follow-ups.

- Respond to routine questions using approved messaging.

- Identify interested creators and organizations and keep those conversations moving.

- Flag promising opportunities or questions requiring founder attention.



4. ClickUp & Daily Reporting



- Update every outreach record with the correct status, contact method, and follow-up information.

- Ensure interested prospects have a clear next step.

- Submit a short, three-line daily report covering:

  - Outreach completed.

  - Replies and interested contacts.

  - Questions, blockers, or anything requiring attention.



Every Week



 Group Admin Outreach



- Review relevant
 groups identified by our AI prospecting system.

- Identify the appropriate administrator or decision-maker.

- Review the group's rules, audience, and recent activity.

- Draft 15 personalized messages to group administrators proposing a relevant MailDay collaboration or community feature.

- Prepare messages for founder approval and sending.

- Track outreach and responses in ClickUp.



Pipeline Management



- Review AI-sourced creator, co-op, and community prospects before outreach.

- Verify accuracy, relevance, and contact information.

- Flag duplicates, incomplete records, and unsuitable prospects.

- Keep the outreach pipeline organized and ready for the following week.

- Ensure interested contacts receive appropriate follow-ups.



What Counts as Completed Work?



We care about quality, not simply checking boxes.



A completed outreach message must:



- Be directed to a relevant, qualified recipient.

- Include accurate, specific personalization.

- Follow our approved brand voice and messaging guidelines.

- Be ready to send without significant rewriting.

- Be accurately documented in ClickUp.



Generic AI-generated personalization, duplicate outreach, incorrect contact information, and incomplete CRM records do not count as completed deliverables.



We encourage using AI to work efficiently, but you MUST verify its output. Copying and pasting AI-generated information without checking it is not acceptable.



If a prospect list doesn't contain enough qualified contacts to meet a daily target, communicate that promptly rather than sending unsuitable outreach.



What We're Looking For



Required:



- Excellent written English, particularly natural and conversational messaging.

- Experience with
 outreach, creator outreach, lead generation, or similar work.

- Strong attention to detail and research verification skills.

- Ability to follow established processes independently.

- Comfortable using AI tools to improve efficiency without sacrificing accuracy.

- Strong organizational skills and consistent follow-through.

- Proactive communication and willingness to ask questions when something is unclear.

- Reliable internet access.



Preferred but not required:



- Experience with ClickUp or similar CRM software.

- Familiarity with Instagram, TikTok, and
 communities.

- Experience working with U.S.-based businesses.

- Interest in homeschooling, parenting, children's education, or family-focused brands.



How We Work



We're a small team, and we value people who take ownership of their responsibilities.



You'll receive access to our established systems, messaging templates, and instructions.



We don't expect perfection on day one, but we do expect you to learn from feedback, catch mistakes before submitting work, and communicate proactively.



You won't be responsible for building prospect lists from scratch, managing paid advertising, creating social media content, or designing marketing materials.



Your job is to make our existing outreach process work consistently and effectively.



Opportunity to Grow



As MailDay grows, this position may expand into a larger Partnerships & Business Development role.



Future responsibilities could include managing creator affiliates, coordinating brand collaborations, developing community partnerships, and overseeing partnership onboarding.



For now, our focus is on excellent outreach execution.



We're looking for someone interested in growing with the company as opportunities develop.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction and your relevant outreach experience.

2. An example of a personalized outreach
 or DM you've written.

3. The AI tools and CRM platforms you've used.

4. Confirmation that you're comfortable with the deliverables.



Please also complete this short writing exercise:



Imagine you're reaching out to a homeschooling mom on Instagram who shares activities and educational resources for her young children.



Write a short, friendly DM introducing MailDay and asking whether she'd be interested in learning about a potential collaboration.



We want to see how you naturally communicate. Please don't send a long, formal sales pitch.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small paid practical assessment before receiving ongoing assignments.

title: Bookkeeper / Accounts & Finance Executive
description:

Your responsibilities



1. Bookkeeping and financial records



Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in QuickBooks.

Collect, check and record supplier invoices, receipts, credit notes and expenses.

Organise supporting documents in Google Drive with clear filing and naming.

Identify missing documents, duplicate entries and incorrect expense classifications, and follow through to resolve them.



2. Bank and e-commerce reconciliation



Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, payment gateways and incoming customer payments.

Reconcile Shopify, Shopee and TikTok Shop sales against settlement reports and actual bank receipts.

Account for platform fees, commissions, vouchers, refunds, returns and settlement timing differences.

Track outstanding settlements and investigate discrepancies without double-counting sales or expenses.



3. Accounts payable and receivable



Maintain supplier payment schedules and customer outstanding balances.

Match invoices against payments and prepare payment lists for approval.

Follow up on missing invoices, payment differences and overdue receivables.

Keep records of supplier deposits and prepayments.



4. Sales, costs and profitability reporting



Update weekly and monthly sales reports by country, platform and SKU.

Track cost of goods, inventory movements, platform fees, advertising, affiliate commissions, logistics and operating expenses.

Prepare monthly management reports, including profit and loss, balance sheet and cash flow summaries.

Highlight unusual expenses, margin changes and gaps between reported sales and cash received.



5. Payroll and finance support



Prepare payroll schedules and supporting calculations for staff, part-time packers, livestream hosts and creators.

Check commissions, incentives, allowances and claims against approved terms.

Maintain payment records and submit calculations for approval.

What we are looking for



At least 5 years of hands-on bookkeeping or accounting experience.

Strong practical experience with QuickBooks Online.

Experience handling accounts for an e-commerce or consumer product business.

Confidence reconciling marketplace settlements, bank accounts and credit cards.

Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, SUMIFS and lookup formulas.

Experience with multiple currencies and more than one business entity.

Good written and spoken English.

Strong attention to detail, confidentiality and ability to meet deadlines.

A proactive approach: you investigate problems, ask clear questions and follow through until they are resolved.

Reliable internet connection and availability during Singapore business hours.



Highly preferred



Experience supporting Singapore or Malaysia businesses, including familiarity with GST-related bookkeeping and CPF payroll records.

Experience with Singapore and Malaysia accounts.

Familiarity with Shopify, Shopee, TikTok Shop, inventory accounting and SKU-level profitability.

An accounting or finance qualification, or equivalent practical experience.



How to apply

This role spends most of its time on day-to-day accounting, billing, and financial recordkeeping, alongside core executive support. The ideal candidate is precise, numbers-minded, and discreet, and enjoys bringing order to invoices, reconciliations, and reports. Experience supporting sales or marketing activities is a welcome bonus, as this role works alongside our Marketing & Events team and helps the hub grow its membership.



ACCOUNTING & FINANCE (PRIMARY FOCUS)

• Accounts Payable: Receive, review, and code vendor invoices; route for approval; schedule payments; and track payment status to ensure vendors are paid accurately and on time.

• Accounts Receivable & Member Billing: Generate and send member invoices for lab, office, and coworking space through Nexudus; apply payments; monitor aging; and follow up on past-due balances professionally.

• Bookkeeping & Reconciliation: Record transactions in the Company's accounting system, perform monthly bank and credit card reconciliations, and reconcile Nexudus billing activity against the general ledger.

• Month-End Close Support: Assist with month-end close tasks, including accruals, journal entry preparation, and gathering supporting documentation for review by leadership or the Company's outside accountant.

• Expense Management: Process employee expense reports and corporate card activity, verify receipts and approvals, and ensure spending aligns with Company policy.

• Budgeting & Reporting: Help prepare and track operating budgets; produce routine financial reports (cash position, A/R aging, A/P summaries, revenue by membership type) and dashboards for leadership.

• Event & Program Budgeting and Reporting: Build and track budgets for hub events and programs (workshops, networking sessions, community gatherings, and educational programs); monitor vendor, venue, catering, and AV costs against budget; record ticketing, registration, and sponsorship revenue; and prepare post-event and program financial summaries showing revenue, expenses, and net results for leadership.

• Payroll & Benefits Coordination: Support payroll processing and recordkeeping through Paychex, including timesheet collection, new-hire and termination updates, and benefits/retirement plan (Paychex/CalSavers) administration.

• Grants, Contracts & Compliance Records: Track contract billing terms and funding-related reporting requirements; maintain organized records to support audits, tax filings, insurance renewals, and vendor compliance (e.g., W-9s and 1099s).

• Vendor & Procurement Support: Maintain vendor files and service agreements, track renewal timelines, obtain quotes, and support purchasing of lab, office, and hub supplies within approved budgets.



EXECUTIVE SUPPORT

• Calendar & Meeting Management: Manage calendars for senior leadership, coordinating internal and external meetings, finance reviews, and cross-functional team sessions.

• Communication: Serve as a point of contact for leadership, handling correspondence, drafting
s, and ensuring prompt responses to members, vendors, and partners.

• Information & Document Management: Organize and maintain sensitive financial records, contracts, and presentations related to hub operations, programs, and key initiatives.

• Project Coordination: Assist leadership with ongoing projects, ensuring timelines are met and stakeholders are kept informed.

• Travel Coordination: Arrange travel and track related expenses for leadership as needed.



SALES & MARKETING SUPPORT (A PLUS)

While accounting and finance come first, candidates who can also contribute in the following areas will stand out:

• Membership Sales Support: Assist with prospective member inquiries, hub tours, proposal and pricing preparation, and membership agreement paperwork.

• CRM Maintenance: Keep member, prospect, and contact records current in Nexudus, including renewals, pipeline status, and activity logs.

• Revenue Insights: Use billing and membership data to help leadership understand occupancy, renewal trends, and pricing opportunities.

• Marketing & Events Coordination: Partner with the Marketing & Events team on event logistics, invitations, materials, and post-event follow-up for workshops, tours, and networking sessions.

• Brand & Content Support: Help prepare presentations, one-pagers, and social or newsletter content that reflect the Company's branding and communication standards.



QUALIFICATIONS



Required

• [3+] years of experience in accounting, bookkeeping, or finance administration, ideally combined with executive or administrative support.

• Hands-on experience with accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoicing, and account reconciliations.

• Proficiency with accounting software (e.g., [QuickBooks Online, Xero], or similar) and strong Microsoft Excel skills (formulas, pivot tables, lookups).

• High attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to manage deadlines across multiple priorities.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, including professional correspondence with members and vendors.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial and personnel information with discretion.



Preferred

• Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Experience with Nexudus or a similar membership/billing platform, and with Paychex or a comparable payroll system.

• Familiarity with month-end close, accruals, and supporting an outside CPA or audit process.

• Experience in sales support, CRM management, or marketing coordination.

• Experience in a coworking, real estate, life science, or startup environment.



WHY JOIN US

Join a mission-driven team at the center of San Diego's life science innovation community. You'll have real ownership of the hub's financial operations, visibility with senior leadership, and opportunities for career growth and professional development as Aquillius continues to expand.

title: AI-Assisted Full-Stack Developer to Build Internal Tools for US Real Estate Company (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:

The client builds its own web apps and tools for leasing, maintenance, tenant communication, project tracking, reporting, and automating admin work. The developer will work directly with company leadership. There is no large dev team, so work gets used by staff right away.



The role involves:



-Building and maintaining internal web apps: dashboards, portals, forms, and databases

-Using AI coding tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.) to work fast, while understanding and checking everything they produce

-Automating repetitive work: spreadsheets, reports,
s, moving data between systems

title: Airbnb STR Remote Virtual Assistant

You will be expected to take ownership of assigned tasks from start to finish, resolve routine issues independently, and communicate clearly when additional support or approval is needed.



Work Schedule

Note that all assigned work must be completed personally. Delegating or outsourcing work to sub-VAs or other individuals is strictly prohibited.





Key Responsibilities

Guest Communication & Reservation Support

Administrative & Listing Support

title: Construction Estimator & Project Administrator I Wunderbuild Specialist
description:
Australian Residential Construction | Remote – Philippines



AUD $12–$18/hour | Negotiable for exceptional experience



20 hours per week initially | Long-term opportunity



ABOUT McDOWELL HOMES



McDowell Homes is an established, family-owned boutique residential building company based in Port Stephens, NSW, Australia. Since 1993, we've specialised in custom homes, duplexes and major renovations throughout Port Stephens, Newcastle and the Hunter Valley. We're a small, hands-on team with high standards. We take pride in our workmanship, attention to detail and reputation for delivering quality homes.



We're looking for an experienced Construction Estimator & Project Administrator with proven Wunderbuild experience to work closely with our Construction Manager and Business Manager.



THE ROLE



This is not a general Virtual Assistant position.



We're looking for someone who genuinely understands Australian residential construction, can confidently interpret architectural and engineering drawings, and has hands-on experience preparing accurate estimates, BOQs and quantity take-offs. Wunderbuild is central to how we manage our business, from estimating and tendering through to project delivery and job costing. We need someone who can contribute from the outset, work independently, identify potential issues and take responsibility for producing accurate, complete work.



Our ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented and comfortable working directly with a busy Construction Manager.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Estimating & Tendering (Primary Focus)

          Prepare detailed quantity take-offs, BOQs and construction estimates.

          Interpret architectural, structural and engineering drawings and specifications.

          Prepare and maintain estimates directly within Wunderbuild.

          Build and maintain estimating templates, cost libraries and standard items.

          Obtain, review and compare supplier and subcontractor quotations.

          Identify scope gaps, omissions, discrepancies and potential cost risks.

          Prepare pricing revisions and assist with variations.

          Ensure estimates accurately reflect the documented project scope.

          Support the tendering process from initial documentation through to final pricing.



2. Project Administration & Cost Management

          Set up and maintain projects within Wunderbuild.

          Prepare and manage purchase orders.

          Review supplier and subcontractor invoices against approved purchase orders.

          Monitor project budgets, expenditure and job costs.

          Assist with construction scheduling and project updates.

          Track variations and maintain accurate project cost records.

          Coordinate subcontractor and supplier quotations, information and follow-ups.

          Maintain organised project documentation and drawing revisions.

          Assist with HazardCo WHS compliance, including subcontractor documentation and inductions.

          Provide general construction administration support as required.



ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS



We're seeking someone with demonstrated experience in the following areas:

- Hands-on Wunderbuild experience, including estimating, project setup, purchase orders and job costing.

- Minimum three years' relevant construction estimating or quantity surveying experience.

- Previous experience working with Australian residential builders.

- Strong understanding of Australian residential construction methods, materials, terminology and trade sequencing.

- Ability to confidently interpret architectural, structural and engineering documentation.

- Proven experience preparing detailed quantity take-offs, BOQs and construction estimates.

- Experience obtaining and comparing supplier and subcontractor quotations.

- Understanding of construction budgets, variations and job cost tracking.

- Exceptional attention to detail and numerical accuracy.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.

- Confidence working independently and communicating proactively.

- Experience with custom homes, duplexes and major renovations is particularly desirable.



SOFTWARE & SYSTEMS



Wunderbuild proficiency is a priority for this position. Please clearly describe your experience using Wunderbuild, including which functions you've used and the tasks you've personally completed.



Experience with the following systems would also be advantageous:

- HazardCo

- Xero

- Dropbox

- Google Drive

- Gmail

- AI productivity tools such as Claude or ChatGPT



We don't expect candidates to know every system. However, we're particularly interested in applicants who can demonstrate practical Wunderbuild experience and strong construction estimating ability.



THE PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Beyond technical skills, we're looking for someone who:

- Takes ownership of their work and follows tasks through to completion.

- Identifies potential problems rather than waiting for someone else to find them.

- Asks questions when information is unclear rather than making assumptions.

- Understands the importance of accuracy when preparing construction estimates.

- Communicates clearly and consistently.

- Enjoys working as part of a small, supportive team.

- Is interested in a stable, long-term role with opportunities to grow.



WORKING HOURS & REMUNERATION



- Initially 20 hours per week, with potential to increase.

- Flexible working arrangements, with regular overlap during Australian Eastern business hours.

- AUD $12–$18 per hour, depending on demonstrated experience and capabilities.



Higher remuneration may be considered for an exceptional candidate with advanced Wunderbuild expertise and proven Australian residential estimating experience.



HOW TO APPLY



Applications must be submitted through OnlineJobs.ph only.



Please do not send applications through
, WhatsApp, Messenger or other channels.



To demonstrate your attention to detail, include "Trades Ct" in your application subject line.



If you have hands-on Wunderbuild experience, add "WB" after "Trades Ct".



PLEASE INCLUDE



- A brief introduction outlining your relevant construction experience.

- Details of your experience working with Australian residential builders and the types of projects you've worked on.

- Your experience preparing BOQs, take-offs and construction estimates.

- Your Wunderbuild experience: How long have you used it? Which functions have you used? What tasks can you confidently complete without supervision?

- An example of a residential construction project you've estimated, including the scope of your involvement.

- Your current availability, preferred working hours and expected hourly rate.

- Technical Screening Question - You receive architectural and structural drawings for a two-storey residential renovation. Before commencing your estimate, what are the first five things you would review or check, and why?



OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS



Shorlisted cantidates will be invited to participate in a structured interview and practical skills assessment. This practical assessment is paid. We value the time and professional expertise involved in completing the work. The assessment will involve interpreting Australian residential construction drawings, preparing quantity take-offs, identifying potential scope discrepancies and documentin assumptions. Cantidates will receive clear instructions, an agreed time allowance and a fixed assessment payment before commencing. Applicants with demonstrated Wunderbuild experience may also be asked to participate in a live software demonstration.



Our goal is to find the right person for a long-term position, and we believe a fair, transparent recruitment process is the best place to start.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

-Creatively matching visuals to narration to keep the story engaging from beginning to end.



-Highlighting important information in articles, screenshots, and other sources.

title: YouTube Gaming Video Editor - Storytelling & Gameplay (Long-Term)
description:
Hi, I run a gaming commentary channel averaging 50 million views per month, and I'm launching a second channel focused on personality-driven gaming content.



I'm looking for a talented video editor to join me long-term and help turn livestream recordings into entertaining, story-driven YouTube videos.



The content will focus on gaming challenges, testing and comparing games, discovering unusual indie games, and funny gameplay experiences.



I'm aiming for approximately 2–3 long-form videos per week, typically around 12–25 minutes long, depending on the content.



I'm specifically looking for someone who understands the storytelling and editing style of personality driven creators like Ludwig, where gameplay follows a premise with a clear goal, establishing stakes, funny moments, and storytelling through gameplay



What you'll be doing



Watching and reviewing raw livestream recordings, typically containing 1.5–3 hours of gameplay footage.



Identifying the most entertaining moments, funny reactions, challenges, and stream moments.



Turning raw gameplay into cohesive, entertaining YouTube videos with a clear narrative.



Building the story around the original premise, including the goal, obstacles, progression, etc



Editing separately recorded talking-head introductions and incorporating relevant B-roll.



Cutting unnecessary downtime while preserving natural conversations, humor, and personality.



Adding appropriate music, sound effects, zooms, simple graphics, and comedic edits.



Maintaining strong pacing and keeping viewers engaged throughout the video.



Suggesting additional narration or context when needed to make the story flow better.



Keeping editing projects organized and editable.



Storytelling is extremely important. I'm looking for someone who understands how to find and construct an entertaining story from raw gameplay, rather than simply cutting together funny moments or adding flashy effects.



The editing should feel natural and personality-driven, allowing funny situations and reactions to breathe while keeping the overall video engaging.



What I'll provide



Raw gameplay and livestream recordings



The original video concept, challenge, or objective



Separately recorded talking-head footage when appropriate



Additional narration or recorded segments when needed



Reference videos and examples of the desired editing style



Feedback and creative direction



You won't need to come up with video topics or record gameplay yourself.



However, you will be responsible for reviewing the footage and identifying the strongest way to tell the story. I won't be providing a fully timestamped list of every moment to include.



Requirements



Experience editing long-form YouTube gaming content



Strong storytelling instincts and understanding of narrative structure



Excellent English comprehension



Ability to independently review hours of gameplay and identify entertaining moments



Strong sense of comedic timing, pacing, and viewer engagement



Familiarity with gaming, streamers, and internet culture



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro preferred



Ability to incorporate gameplay, facecam, B-roll, and simple motion graphics



Organized project management and reliable communication



Ability to maintain consistent quality and meet agreed deadlines



Advanced motion graphics are not required. I'm much more interested in someone who understands storytelling, knows which moments to keep, and can make a video entertaining without overediting it.



Every completed video should include:



A final exported video ready for YouTube



An organized, editable project file



Upon request, a consolidated project folder containing the necessary media assets to reopen and edit the project on another computer.



This is a pay-per-video position, with the opportunity for consistent, long-term work.



The goal is to produce approximately 2–3 videos per week once we establish a reliable workflow.



Compensation will be agreed upon per video based on the amount of raw footage, expected finished length, and editing complexity.



I'm looking for someone who can work efficiently while maintaining good storytelling and editing quality.



How to apply



Please include:



Three examples of your best and most relevant long-form gaming videos, preferably involving gameplay challenges, comparisons, or personality-driven content.



Your expected rate per video in USD for a 15–20-minute finished video created from approximately 2–3 hours of raw gameplay.



Your average editing time for a project of that size, including watching and reviewing the original footage.



Your available working hours, and how many videos you can realistically complete per week.



A brief explanation of your experience turning raw gameplay into entertaining, story-driven videos.



Which editing software you use.



Please include the word cheeseburger somewhere in your application so I know you've read the entire posting.



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid test edit using raw gameplay footage and references that I provide.



Long-term opportunity



I'm looking for a reliable, creative, long-term collaborator who can help build this gaming channel as it grows.



I'll provide clear video concepts, references, and feedback, but I'm also looking for someone who can bring their own storytelling instincts and creative ideas to the editing process.



There's room for increased responsibilities, consistent projects, and compensation as the channel develops.

title: Senior Cold Caller (Outbound Specialist)
description:
Senior Cold Caller (Outbound Specialist)

Arkero | Fully remote | Australian business hours



About Arkero

Arkero is an Australian recruitment firm placing skilled Philippines-based professionals with businesses across Australia and New Zealand. We specialise in four sectors: Trade & Construction, Real Estate, NDIS & Healthcare, and Accounting. As we grow, we’re looking for an experienced cold caller to lead from the front on the phones.



The role

You’ll make high-volume outbound calls to Australian and New Zealand business owners, book qualified discovery calls, and help train our BDMs to do the same. You report to our Sales Lead. This is a hands-on calling role: you’ll set the standard on the phones every day.



What you’ll do



Make high-volume outbound calls to business owners in our four sectors, from tradies to real estate principals to practice managers.

Get past gatekeepers, reach decision makers, qualify real hiring needs and book discovery calls.

Handle objections with confidence, such as “tried a VA, didn’t work” or “too busy, mate.”

Coach BDMs through call shadowing, live role-plays, call reviews and building an objection-handling library.

Help sharpen our call scripts and openers.

Log every call and next step in the CRM, and post an end-of-day report.



What success looks like



Consistently high daily call volume and conversations.

A steady flow of discovery calls booked that actually show up.

BDMs improving their call numbers and conversions.

Placements coming from the pipeline you’ve built.



What we need from you



10+ years of outbound cold calling, ideally B2B to small and medium businesses.

A proven track record with real numbers: calls per day, meetings booked, deals closed.

Experience calling Australian, NZ, UK or US businesses. Australian experience is a big plus.

Excellent spoken English, and you’re comfortable with straight-talking Aussie business owners.

Experience training or coaching other callers.

Comfortable with CRMs and cloud dialers.

A quiet workspace, quality headset, reliable internet and a backup connection.



Hours and pay

Monday to Friday, Australian business hours (AEST), fully remote. Hourly pay plus performance bonuses.



How to apply

Send all three of the following. Applications missing any of them won’t be reviewed.



Your resume, with company names and dates.

Your numbers from your most recent cold-calling role: average calls per day, conversations per day, meetings booked per week, and deals closed per month (with currency).

title: Remote Sales & Enrollment Rep — Dance Studio (Part Time to Full Time Opportunity).
description:
IF SALES CONVERSATIONS ENERGIZE YOU AND YOU HATE LETTING A LEAD GO COLD, THIS ROLE WAS BUILT FOR YOU.



We are a dance studio that has built something real in our community. What we do goes far beyond teaching dance. We build confidence, friendships, leadership, and skills that stay with people for life. Every family that reaches out to us is already looking for that. Your job is to make sure they find it, and to bring more people into what we are building.



We are hiring one person to own this role. Not manage it. Own it.





WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS



This is a part time, remote sales role. The heart of it is outbound and inbound outreach to warm leads, real people who have already expressed interest in the studio. Your job is to be the first voice they hear, build genuine connection quickly, and guide them toward enrollment through real conversations.



When lead flow is strong, you are following up. When there is downtime, you are prospecting, going out and finding new families through social media, community groups, and online platforms. You are not waiting for things to come to you. You are making them happen.



You will also support the studio with weekly
s to leads and occasionally contribute to social media content. These are a small part of the role, but they are consistent and they count.



This role has a real growth path. If you are consistently converting leads and bringing new families into the studio, the hours are there to grow with you. The right person will not stay part time for long.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Contact new leads immediately when they come in. Speed is a real advantage in enrollment. First contact almost always wins.



- Follow up with prospective families and adult students through calls, texts, and
s using a structured cadence.



- Manage your pipeline and know where every lead stands at all times. Log your activity and report daily.



- Prospect for new leads during downtime through social media, community groups, and online platforms.



- Write weekly
s to leads and support social media content as needed.



- Show up as a true team player. The studio owner may occasionally bring you into tasks outside your core scope. If it supports the studio's growth, you are in. That flexibility and willingness to contribute is something we value deeply in whoever joins this team.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



These are our priorities, in order:



- Phone presence above everything else. You need to sound calm, natural, and confident on every call. Not scripted. Not stiff. The kind of person who can hold a real conversation, earn trust quickly, and move it forward without forcing anything. If that description fits you, you are already ahead of most applicants.



- Fluent in spoken and written English at a C1 level or higher. This will be assessed.



- Experienced in sales, outreach, appointment setting, or enrollment based roles.



- Organized and reliable. You manage your leads, report your activity, and stay on top of follow ups without needing reminders.



- Self directed and comfortable working independently.



- Energized by conversations and motivated by real results.



- Familiar with CRM tools or lead tracking systems. Helpful but not required.



A background or interest in dance is a nice bonus. It is absolutely not required.





SCHEDULE



- 20 hours per week, spread across 7 days.



- The bulk of your hours fall on weekdays.



- Weekends are light, typically 1 to 3 hours, focused on inbound leads only. No outbound on weekends.



- Hours are scheduled within a window of 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM Pacific Time. Your actual schedule within that window is set with the studio owner and may shift by season. It will always be discussed and agreed on in advance.





TWO WEEK TRIAL PERIOD



The role begins with a 2 week trial period to make sure there is a strong fit on both sides. During this time, we will be looking closely at reliability, communication, follow through, organization, quality of work, and how effectively you manage leads without needing constant direction.



At the end of the 2 weeks, we will review performance together and d
 whether to continue the role long term.





COMPENSATION



$250 per month, paid bi weekly via Wise.



This starts as a part time role. If you are consistently bringing new families into the studio, even a handful a month, there is a genuine path to full time. We want to give more hours to someone who is making the most of the ones they have. Results open doors here.





WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS



Every family that contacts this studio is already hoping for something meaningful. A place where their child grows. A community they can belong to. Your follow up, your voice, your consistency, that is what turns their interest into a yes. The right person in this role does not just fill a position. They change outcomes for real families.





TO APPLY



Send your resume and a short introduction. Tell us about a time you followed up with someone consistently and it made a real difference.



Include "Buzz Lightyear" in your subject line or message title. We read every application that includes it. Think of it as the first small sign that you are someone who reads carefully and follows through, two things that matter a lot in this role.

title: Financial Controller — U.S. Accounting & Financial Planning. U.S. Business / Travel Marketplace
description:
Livily is a corporate travel marketplace connecting business travelers with professionally managed vacation rentals. We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Chief Financial Officer to partner directly with the CEO and lead financial strategy, reporting, cash management, and the finance team as the business scales.



This role combines executive judgment with detailed financial execution. You should be comfortable building financial models, reviewing reconciliations, improving accounting processes, and turning financial data into clear business decisions.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own budgeting, forecasting, scenario planning, and a rolling 13-week cash-flow forecast.

• Lead timely monthly closes and accurate profit-and-loss, balance-sheet, and cash-flow reporting across multiple entities, including intercompany reconciliations and consolidated reporting.

• Oversee the accounting team, external accountants, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll coordination, and reconciliations.

• Build management dashboards tracking revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, operating expenses, working capital, and performance against budget.

• Improve booking-to-cash reconciliation across customer collections, payment processors, booking channels, refunds, commissions, and property-manager payouts.

• Strengthen revenue-recognition processes, internal controls, payment approvals, financial SOPs, and audit readiness.

• Evaluate channel economics, pricing, marketing spend, hiring plans, and growth investments; explain the financial implications to leadership.

• Manage banking relationships and financing analysis, and prepare lender, board, and investor reporting when needed.

• Coordinate U.S. tax and compliance work with external CPAs and advisors.

• Develop the finance team, establish clear ownership and deadlines, and use automation to improve reporting accuracy and efficiency.



QUALIFICATIONS

• 10+ years of progressive finance/accounting experience, including 5+ years leading a finance function as CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, or equivalent.

• Strong experience supporting U.S. businesses, with working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and multi-entity accounting.

• Proven ability to manage cash flow, build integrated financial models, and deliver reliable forecasts and executive reporting.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills and strong QuickBooks Online experience.

• Excellent written and spoken English, strong business judgment, and confidence challenging assumptions with evidence.

• A hands-on approach, high attention to detail, and a record of improving accountability and financial processes.

• Degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA, CMA, or equivalent qualification strongly preferred.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

• Travel, hospitality, vacation rentals, online marketplaces, SaaS, or other transaction-heavy businesses.

• Payment processor reconciliation, chargebacks, partner payouts, and marketplace unit economics.

• Fundraising support, due diligence, lender reporting, or acquisition analysis.

• Business intelligence tools and finance automation.



WORK ARRANGEMENT

• Remote, Philippines-based.

• Full-time, approximately 40 hours per week.

• Regular overlap with U.S. business hours is required; exact schedule to be agreed.

• Reports directly to the CEO.

• Compensation is negotiable based on experience and qualifications.



FIRST 90 DAYS

• Assess financial reporting, cash visibility, close processes, and internal controls.

• Establish a reliable cash forecast and a clear monthly reporting package.

• Identify priority reconciliation issues, margin opportunities, and process improvements, with owners and deadlines.



HOW TO APPLY

Please submit:

1. Your resume and relevant professional qualifications.

2. A brief summary of the U.S. businesses you have supported, your leadership responsibilities, and the size of the finance teams you have managed.

3. Two specific examples of how you improved cash flow, profitability, reporting, or financial controls, including measurable results where possible.

4. Your experience with QuickBooks Online, multi-entity accounting, financial modeling, and marketplace or hospitality finance.

5. Your expected monthly compensation in USD, availability to start, and availability for U.S. working-hour overlap.



Use “CFO – Livily” as your application subject. Please anonymize examples and do not include confidential information from current or former employers.

title: Guest Support & Reservations Agent — Level I & Level II
description:
Department: Reservations & Guest Experience

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote / Hybrid, depending on the role and experience



Livily is hiring Guest Support & Reservations Agents to support travelers, corporate clients, and property partners throughout the booking and guest experience—from initial inquiries and reservations to in-stay support and issue resolution.



We’re looking for hospitality professionals who communicate clearly, pay attention to details, and take ownership of guest requests. We are hiring at two levels, with placement based on relevant experience, system proficiency, and demonstrated ability to handle complex situations.



REQUIRED FOR BOTH LEVELS

• Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management or a closely related field.

• Strong spoken and written English.

• A professional, empathetic approach to guest service.

• Accurate documentation, strong organizational skills, and consistent follow-through.

• Confidence managing multiple conversations and priorities in a fast-paced environment.



LEVEL I — GUEST SUPPORT & RESERVATIONS AGENT

You will handle day-to-day guest inquiries and reservation requests, following established procedures and escalating issues when needed.



Responsibilities

• Respond to guest inquiries by phone,
, and chat.

• Assist with new reservations, booking modifications, cancellations, and general questions.

• Explain property amenities, booking policies, check-in instructions, and stay details accurately.

• Support guests before arrival, during their stay, and after departure.

• Maintain accurate reservation records and document interactions in the appropriate systems.

• Coordinate routine requests with property and operations teams.

• Escalate complex or urgent issues with clear notes and relevant context.

• Follow up on open requests and keep guests informed until resolution.



Qualifications

• 2–4 years of experience in hospitality, reservations, hotel operations, or customer support.

• Strong customer service skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to follow procedures while recognizing when an issue requires escalation.

• Familiarity with reservation systems, property management systems (PMS), or CRM platforms is a plus.



LEVEL II — SENIOR GUEST SUPPORT & RESERVATIONS AGENT

You will handle complex bookings and escalations, coordinate resolutions across teams, and help strengthen the quality of guest support.



Responsibilities

• Perform core guest support and reservation duties while taking ownership of more complex cases.

• Manage corporate bookings, multi-property stays, and complicated reservation changes.

• Resolve escalated guest and property-partner concerns with professionalism and urgency.

• Investigate booking discrepancies and coordinate solutions with operations, revenue, and partnership teams.

• Apply company policies consistently and exercise sound judgment within established authority.

• Keep guests and partners informed throughout the resolution process.

• Serve as a resource for Level I agents on systems, policies, and workflows.

• Support training, mentoring, and improvements to internal documentation.

• Identify recurring issues and recommend practical process improvements.



Qualifications

• 3+ years of relevant experience in reservations, hotel operations, or advanced customer support.

• Demonstrated experience independently resolving escalations and complex booking issues.

• Strong problem-solving, conflict-resolution, and prioritization skills.

• Experience with PMS platforms, channel managers, online travel agencies (OTAs), or corporate travel platforms preferred.

• Ability to coordinate across teams and take responsibility for cases through resolution.



WHAT WE OFFER

• Competitive compensation based on role level and experience.

• Growth opportunities within a growing hospitality platform.

• A collaborative team focused on service quality and operational performance.

• Exposure to corporate travel, short-term rentals, and multi-channel booking operations.



HOW TO APPLY

Please submit your resume and include:

1. The level you are applying for: Level I or Level II.

2. How many years of customer support experience do you have? How many of those years were in hospitality, guest support, or reservations?

3. Your degree and relevant qualifications.

4. The reservation, PMS, CRM, OTA, or ticketing platforms you have used.

5. A brief example of a challenging guest issue you resolved, including your actions and the outcome.

6. Your availability and preferred working arrangement.



For Level II, please also describe your experience handling escalations, complex reservations, or mentoring other agents.

title: Experienced Bookkeeper – QuickBooks, AR & Revenue Reconciliation
description:
Livily is looking for an experienced Bookkeeper to maintain accurate, complete financial records in QuickBooks. This is a full-cycle bookkeeping role that includes accounts receivable, revenue recognition, and payment reconciliation.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Maintain day-to-day bookkeeping in QuickBooks, including transaction categorization, general ledger entries, and supporting documentation.

• Manage accounts receivable: prepare and track invoices, apply customer payments, monitor aging balances, follow up on outstanding amounts, and investigate discrepancies.

• Manage accounts payable: record bills, reconcile vendor statements, and track amounts due.

• Record revenue in the correct accounting period under the company’s accounting policies, including tracking deposits, advance payments, deferred revenue, refunds, and adjustments.

• Reconcile customer and reservation payments across booking records, payment processors, bank deposits, and QuickBooks. Investigate missing, duplicate, partial, or unmatched payments, fees, refunds, and chargebacks.

• Complete bank, credit card, and clearing-account reconciliations and resolve differences.

• Support month-end close, prepare adjusting journal entries, and maintain reconciliation schedules.

• Prepare accurate financial reports, including profit and loss, balance sheet, and accounts receivable aging reports.

• Work with the Head Accountant to resolve accounting issues and maintain reliable records and controls.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• At least 5 years of hands-on, full-cycle bookkeeping experience.

• At least 5 years of hands-on QuickBooks experience, including reconciliations, journal entries, and financial reporting.

• Experience covering accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, month-end close, and financial statements. AR-only or collections-only experience does not meet this requirement.

• Practical understanding of accrual accounting, revenue recognition, deferred revenue, and payment reconciliation.

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and confidence working with CSV files and large transaction lists.

• Strong attention to detail, clear written communication, and the ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies independently.



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience in hospitality, property management, short-term rentals, or reservation-based businesses.

• Experience reconciling booking-platform payouts and payment-processor settlements.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include your resume and answer the following:

1. How many years of full-cycle bookkeeping experience do you have, and which responsibilities did you handle?

2. How many years have you used QuickBooks, and which versions (Online, Desktop, or both)?

3. Describe your experience with month-end close and preparing financial statements.

4. Give an example of a payment reconciliation discrepancy you investigated and resolved.

5. Explain how you have handled customer deposits or advance payments before the related revenue was earned.

Please describe examples without sharing confidential client information.

description:

You’ll lead 15+ CX agents and multiple Team Leads, while owning the systems, data, automation, and processes that allow CX to scale efficiently.



This is not a “manage the support team” job. It’s a “build, optimize, and scale the entire customer experience engine” job.



What you’ll actually own:



1. Team Leadership

Lead and develop 15+ CX agents through multiple Team Leads.

Own:

Team Lead and agent performance

Training, QA, coaching, and accountability

Staffing, coverage, and workforce planning

SOPs, escalation processes, and team structure

You should be experienced managing managers, not just individual contributors.



2. Gorgias, Automation & AI

Own and continuously optimize our CX technology.



Deep expertise in:

Gorgias macros, rules, automations, tags, routing, and reporting

AI-powered support and agent assistance

Self-service, FAQ and knowledge base

Workflow automation

QA and ticket categorization

Constantly ask: What can be automated, eliminated, or made better?

Improve:

Pre-purchase sales and conversion

Product recommendations and customer education

Post-purchase communication

Shipping and fulfillment experience

Returns, refunds, and cancellations

Retention and save-the-sale opportunities

Customer self-service

Understand how CX impacts conversion, AOV, retention, and LTV, not just CSAT.



4. Data, Refunds & Revenue Protection



Own CX analytics and identify the root cause behind:

Refunds

Cancellations

Returns

Chargebacks

Ticket volume

Customer retention

Agent productivity

Build strategies to prevent refunds and chargebacks—not just process them.



5. Multi-Channel & Operations

Own CX across Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and Social Channel comments, including their different customer-service requirements and policies.



Partner closely with Operations on:

Shipping delays

Lost/damaged packages

Fulfillment issues

Inventory problems

International shipping

Proactive customer communication



6. Voice of Customer

Turn customer interactions into actionable business intelligence.

Identify recurring:

Customer objections

Product questions

Complaints

Sentiment trends

Reasons for refunds/cancellations

Bring those insights to Ecommerce, Marketing, Product, Creative, and Operations.



What success looks like:



First 30 days:

Audit Gorgias, macros, workflows, automation, and AI.

Evaluate Team Lead/agent performance.

Identify major ticket, refund, cancellation, and chargeback drivers.

Build a 90 day CX roadmap.



First 90 days:

Implement 90 day CX roadmap

Major Gorgias and automation improvements shipped.

Meaningful AI implementation and optimization.

Clear team performance standards.

Identify pre-purchase/post-purchase flow opportunities.

Reduced unnecessary tickets and operational friction.

Improvements in CSAT, refunds, cancellations, and chargebacks.



Ongoing



Success is measured by:

CSAT | Refunds | Cancellations | Chargebacks | AI Automation |Ticket Volume | Revenue Influenced by CX



Requirements:



5+ years CX/customer service experience with DTC ecommerce

Experience managing 15+ agents and multiple Team Leads.

Proven experience managing managers.

Extensive, hands-on Gorgias experience.

Strong Shopify/ecommerce experience.

Experience optimizing pre- and post-purchase customer flows.

Deep experience with Gorgias macros, automations, rules, and workflows.

Strong CX data and analytics experience.

Experience with refunds, cancellations, returns, and chargebacks.

Heavy, practical use of AI and automation.

Experience in a high-volume, fast-growth environment.



Strongly preferred:



Experience across Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and Walmart.

7–8+ figure DTC experience.

Experience with retention, LTV, and save-the-sale strategies.

Experience building CX KPI/reporting systems.

Strong understanding of fulfillment and ecommerce operations.

Experience using AI to materially reduce support workload.





This is probably not for you if:



You’ve only managed a small support team.

You’ve never managed Team Leads/managers.

Your Gorgias experience is primarily as an agent.

You think CX is simply about answering tickets faster.

You’re not highly analytical.

You don’t actively use AI to improve workflows.

You prefer maintaining systems rather than constantly optimizing them.

Your resume or LinkedIn.
