title: Executive Administrative Assistant to CPA Firm Owner
description:
CPA Firm Administrative Assistant — Executive Support & Tax Workflow



We are a growing CPA tax and accounting advisory firm serving business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs.



We are hiring an organized, proactive Administrative Assistant with CPA or tax accounting firm experience to keep client work moving and protect the owner’s time.



This role is ideal for someone who understands how a tax practice operates, communicates professionally with clients, follows up consistently for missing information, and maintains complete, well-organized digital files.



Prior CPA or tax accounting firm experience is required. TaxDome and Intuit ProConnect Tax experience are strong advantages.



Who This Role Is For



You may be a great fit if you:



Take ownership of tasks and follow through without repeated reminders.



Anticipate needs and resolve routine administrative issues independently.



Enjoy organizing documents, tracking outstanding items, and keeping workflows current.



Communicate clearly, courteously, and confidently with clients.



Follow established procedures, recognize exceptions, and ask for guidance when needed.



Protect the owner’s time by prioritizing communications and preparing clear updates.



Welcome feedback and improve quickly.



Required Qualifications



At least 3 years of administrative or client service experience in a CPA or tax accounting firm, including direct responsibility for collecting tax documents, following up with clients, and maintaining organized client files. Law firm experience alone does not meet this requirement.



Basic familiarity with common tax documents, including W-2s, 1099s, K-1s, prior-year returns, and business financial statements.



Experience tracking missing client information and following up until items are received or escalated.



Strong digital document organization skills, including consistent file naming and accurate organization by client, entity, tax year, and document type.



Professional written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain document requests in plain language.



Experience using secure client portals and handling confidential information.



Strong attention to detail, time management, and ability to manage competing priorities.



Proficiency with spreadsheets for tracking, lists, and basic formulas.



Comfort using scheduling tools, office software, and client or task management systems.



Preferred Qualifications



5+ years of relevant CPA or tax accounting firm experience, particularly supporting a firm owner and coordinating client work during busy tax seasons.



TaxDome experience, including client communications, document management, tasks, and workflow tracking.



Intuit ProConnect Tax experience.



QuickBooks experience.



Experience managing an executive’s calendar and inbox.



Key Responsibilities



1. Client Follow-Up & Document Collection



Send clear, specific requests for missing documents using firm-approved checklists and team guidance.



Maintain an accurate list of outstanding information for each client.



Follow up consistently and professionally until items are received or require escalation.



Review submissions for administrative completeness and flag missing, unreadable, duplicate, or incorrectly dated documents.



Route technical tax questions to the appropriate team member.



2. Document Organization & TaxDome Management



Upload, label, and organize documents by client, entity, tax year, and document type.



Maintain accurate client records, tasks, deadlines, and workflow statuses in TaxDome.



Follow established procedures and flag exceptions promptly.



Identify stalled work, clarify the next action, and follow up with the appropriate person.



Give the owner concise updates on outstanding items, approaching deadlines, and decisions needed.



3. Scheduling & Calendar Management



Manage the firm owner’s calendar and schedule client calls, internal meetings, and follow-ups.



Anticipate scheduling conflicts and allow appropriate preparation and follow-up time.



Send confirmations, reminders, and rescheduling notices.



Prepare meeting materials and track resulting action items.



4. Inbox Management & Client Communication



Monitor designated firm inboxes and acknowledge messages promptly and professionally.



Filter, prioritize, and route communications appropriately.



Resolve routine administrative questions within established guidelines.



Protect the owner’s focus while ensuring urgent client issues reach the right person promptly.



Prepare clear summaries with relevant background and the action or decision needed.



5. Administrative & Billing Support



Prepare and send invoices.



Track payments and follow up on outstanding balances.



Maintain organized digital records, templates, and checklists.



Review administrative documents for accuracy, spelling, formatting, and completeness.



Provide basic QuickBooks support, depending on experience and assigned responsibilities.



6. Additional Firm Support



Help document recurring tasks in simple checklists and standard operating procedures.



Support firm projects and occasional
 marketing or social media scheduling as capacity allows.



Newsletter, Marketing, social media management



Learn new tools and systems as the firm grows.



Technology & Systems



Our tools include TaxDome, Intuit ProConnect Tax, QuickBooks, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Zoom, GHL, and scheduling platforms.



You should be comfortable learning software and using technology to keep work organized. Prior TaxDome and ProConnect experience will receive strong consideration.



What Success Looks Like



The owner spends less time chasing documents and answering routine administrative questions.



Client folders are organized, accurate, and easy to navigate.



Outstanding information has a clear status and next follow-up action.



Clients receive specific requests and consistent, courteous follow-up.



Workflow records reflect the actual status of each engagement.



Issues are raised early, with enough context for the team to act.



Scheduling and administrative tasks are handled reliably with minimal oversight.



Work Environment & Growth Opportunity



Expected hours: 20–40 per week, with a part-time or full-time schedule established before hiring.



Long-term opportunity to grow into an Operations or Office Manager role.



Direct collaboration with the firm owner.



A professional environment that values accuracy, responsiveness, accountability, and continuous improvement.



Compensation



Compensation will be based on relevant experience, qualifications, and the agreed scope and schedule.



How to Apply



Please submit your résumé and answer all six questions below. We review responses for relevant experience, clear communication, and attention to instructions. Applications with incomplete responses will not be considered.



Application Questions



To confirm that you read the job description carefully, type the word ORGANIZED in ALL CAPS.



How many years have you worked in a CPA or tax accounting firm? Briefly describe the responsibilities you personally handled during tax season.



Describe how you tracked missing client documents and followed up until the information was received. Include how you handled clients who did not respond.



Which tax documents have you regularly collected, reviewed for completeness, or organized?



Have you used TaxDome and Intuit ProConnect Tax? For each, describe the tasks you personally performed and when you last used it. If you have not used either platform, list any comparable systems you have used.



Write a brief follow-up
 to a fictional client who has not responded to your request for missing tax documents. Identify the missing documents, explain the next step, and keep the tone professional and courteous. Use fictional details only; do not include confidential client information.



Please keep each response to questions 2–5 to approximately 2–4 sentences.



Interview Process



Review of your résumé and application responses.



An interview focused on CPA firm experience, client communication, judgment, and ownership.



A practical exercise using fictional client materials to assess document organization, identification of missing information, prioritization, and written follow-up.



A Note from the Firm Owner



We are looking for someone who takes pride in keeping work organized and following through. If you understand the pace of a CPA firm, enjoy helping clients complete the next step, and can take administrative work off the owner’s plate, we would love to hear from you.

title: AI Automation & Workflow Specialist
description:
Job Type: Project-Based / Part-Time, with Potential for Long-Term Engagement

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced AI Automation & Workflow Specialist who can help us identify, design, and implement automations across our business operations.

 

Our goal is to reduce repetitive manual work, improve efficiency, and streamline workflows across administrative and clinical operations. This may include tasks related to invoicing, payroll, clinical backend management, task tracking, reporting, and other operational processes.

 

We need someone who can assess our existing workflows, identify what can be automated, recommend the right tools or platforms, and implement practical solutions. We may also explore new software or platforms, so we need someone who can evaluate different options and help us determine the best approach.

 

This is not just a role for someone who knows how to use AI tools. We want someone who understands workflow automation and system integrations, and can translate that knowledge into working solutions.

 

Key Responsibilities



Workflow Assessment: Review existing administrative and clinical operations workflows to identify repetitive tasks, bottlenecks, and opportunities for automation.

AI Automation: Design and implement AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.

Administrative Automation: Explore automations for invoicing, payroll-related processes, reporting, data entry, reconciliation, and other administrative tasks.

Clinical Operations Automation: Identify opportunities to streamline non-clinical backend processes, task tracking, documentation workflows, and operational reporting while maintaining appropriate privacy and compliance safeguards.

System Integrations: Connect existing tools and platforms to automate information transfer, notifications, task creation, and routine processes.

Platform Evaluation: Research and recommend suitable tools or platforms based on our needs, budget, and existing workflows. Help us understand what can be automated before we commit to a new platform.

Project Implementation: Build, test, document, and improve automations, ensuring they work reliably and can be maintained.

Process Documentation: Create clear workflow diagrams, SOPs, and instructions so our team can understand and manage the systems.



Tools & Platforms



Experience with some of the following is preferred:

Workflow automation: Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar tools

AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, AI agents, and other AI-powered workflow tools

Project and task management: Asana, Trello, Notion

Customer support and communication: Slack, Microsoft Teams

Business systems: QuickBooks, CRM systems, and other administrative tools

Integrations: APIs, webhooks, and third-party app integrations

Experience in the tools above is preferred but you do not need to know every tool listed above. We are also interested in someone who can learn new platforms quickly and recommend the right solution for each use case.

 

Requirements



Proven experience building automations or improving business workflows.

Practical knowledge of AI automation and workflow integration tools.

Ability to analyse a process and determine whether it should be automated, redesigned, or handled manually.

Experience connecting multiple applications and troubleshooting automation issues.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.

Able to explain technical concepts and solutions in simple, practical terms.

Experience handling sensitive business or healthcare-related workflows is an advantage.

Understanding of data privacy, access controls, and appropriate safeguards when working with sensitive information.

Important: We are looking for someone who can bring recommendations and technical expertise to the table. We need a problem-solver who can help us figure out what is possible, which tools to use, and how to implement the solution — not someone who needs step-by-step instructions for every task.

 

Work Arrangement



Remote work.

Project-based or part-time, depending on the scope of work.

Potential for ongoing, long-term engagement if the collaboration is successful.

Flexible hours, with deliverables and timelines agreed upon for each project.

Compensation based on experience, expertise, and project requirements.

If you have a portfolio, case studies, or workflow diagrams you can share without disclosing confidential client information, please include them.

Application Form: AI Automation & Workflow Specialist

title: Senior SEO & Conversion Strategist
description:
We’re Ezy Pzy Finance, an Australian company that connects small and medium businesses with fast business funding through a panel of lenders. Our sales, automation and paid ads are mature and well run. Organic search is our biggest untapped channel, and we want one senior person to own it completely.



This is not a “do the tasks we give you” role. You’ll d
 the strategy, build the plan, execute it, and be measured on one thing: funded deals from organic search.





What you’ll own:



- SEO strategy: audits, keyword mapping and prioritisation for a competitive finance niche

- Programmatic and landing pages: industry, situation and location pages at scale, each with real substance

- Content: articles with genuine buyer intent, plus refreshing existing pages

- Digital PR and link earning: turning our real lending data into reports journalists and finance sites want to cite, plus partnerships with accountants and industry bodies

- Conversion optimisation: A/B testing our landing pages and application flow, which also serves our paid traffic

- AI search visibility: getting us cited in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity

- Technical SEO: site health, schema, speed and internal linking, writing specs for our developer when needed

- Reporting: a monthly report tying organic traffic to leads and funded deals, not vanity rankings





You must have:



- 5+ years of hands-on SEO, including owning strategy (not just executing someone else’s)

- Proven results you can show: traffic and lead growth with screenshots from Search Console or Analytics

- Experience in finance, legal, health or another YMYL niche (strongly preferred)

- Conversion rate optimisation experience (A/B testing, landing page work)

- Strong written English, good enough to write content for Australian business owners

- Comfort with Ahrefs or Semrush, Search Console, GA4 and WordPress





What we offer:



- US$2,000–3,000/month base, depending on experience

- Uncapped commissions: 10% of our net commission on every new client funded through organic search (our average deal pays US$300+ to you)

- Paid tools (Ahrefs or Semrush) and a separate budget for PR and outreach

- Real ownership: you set the plan, with no micromanagement

- A long-term role in a stable, growing business





Hours of work

6am–3pm PH time 





How to apply:



- Start your message with the words “Organic Growth”, so we know you read this ad.

- Record a Loom video (max 10 minutes) auditing 
. Tell us the top 3 things you’d fix or build first and why, and what you’d deliberately not do.

- Share one case study with real numbers: what the situation was, what you did, and what happened to traffic and leads and how long it took.

- In 2–3 sentences, explain how you’d earn high-quality links for a finance company without buying them.

Applications without the Loom video won’t be reviewed.

About the Role

We are looking for an Operations & Systems Manager to own day-to-day execution across people, processes, systems, and technology.



In this role, you will be the first point of contact for work-related and system problems—ensuring issues are investigated, resolved, delegated, automated, or escalated appropriately before reaching Leadership. This is a multi-hat position for an operations-minded problem solver who knows how to connect the pieces between project management, CRMs, automations, and team execution to keep the entire system running smoothly.



What Success Looks Like

Problems are identified, investigated, and solved before reaching Leadership. You understand operational and technical blockers, determine the required actions, assign the right team members, and follow tasks through to resolution.



Key Responsibilities

* Operations Management: Keep projects, deliverables, and weekly priorities moving smoothly across Sales, Marketing,    Operations, and IT.

* Process Optimization: Identify bottlenecks, simplify workflows, refine SOPs, and eliminate unnecessary manual work.

* Systems Management: Oversee how CRM, payments, automations, communication tools, and internal systems connect and flow together.

* Technical Coordination: Translate business and operational problems into clear technical requirements and briefs for developers and automation specialists.

* Team Management: Run 1:1 meetings, track team performance, coach underperformance, and hold staff accountable to key deliverables.

* Problem Resolution: Act as the first line of defense to troubleshoot operational or technical issues before escalating to Leadership.

* SOP & Quality Control: Ensure established processes for payments, invoicing, commissions, sourcing, and onboarding are strictly followed.

* Hiring & Onboarding: Support final candidate interviews for specialist roles and manage end-to-end onboarding for new hires.



Technical & Core Requirements

*  CRM Operations: Daily working experience inside CRMs (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or similar)—managing contacts, pipelines, tags, custom fields, and smart lists, as well as troubleshooting data discrepancies.

* Automation Logic: Ability to read and understand workflows in GoHighLevel, Make, Zapier, or n8n (triggers, actions, filters, conditions) and identify where a flow broke using run history.

* Integration Fundamentals: Solid grasp of how platforms exchange data (webhooks, API connections, field mapping) and why records fail to sync (e.g.,
 mismatches across Shopify and CRM).

title: Senior Short-Form Video Editor and Content Researcher (Part-Time)
description:
About Us

We are a small Australian performance marketing consultancy. We run Google and Meta ads for businesses in Australia, Europe and the US. Our founder worked at Google and Meta before starting the company. We all work remotely.



About The Role

We are looking for a senior short-form video editor who also designs clean graphics, researches what works, and brings us ideas without being asked. Someone proactive, sharp and hard-working, who understands what Australian, European and US audiences respond to.



The role grows in phases. First, our own content: our channels and the ads for our own products. Once that is running well, you also produce ad creative for our clients, starting with a European consumer-finance brand, in each client’s brand and under our name.



We or the client d
 what to make. You bring the research and ideas that make that decision better, and you make the work excellent.



Hours and Pay

About 20 hours a week, with hours that overlap Melbourne time. US$1,000 a month, more for exceptional senior experience. A monthly contract, reviewed as the role grows. If client work needs more hours, we agree them and pay for them. We judge the work on outcomes, not hours logged.



What You Would Do: Make

* Around 5 short videos, 2 carousels and 2 video covers a week for our own channels, more once client work starts.

* Edit talking-head and B-roll footage into 15 to 60 second vertical videos (9:16, 1080 x 1920). Use the script, hook and call to action exactly as written.

* Export for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. YouTube Shorts is our main reach channel. No music baked into exports, and no TikTok shorter than 7 seconds.

* Turn scripts and stock or client footage into fast, authentic ad videos: the product in the first seconds, quick cuts, every line on screen so the ad works with the sound off.

* Design static posts, carousels and ad graphics from our templates and brand guides (Canva or Figma), in every size we need.

* Cut ad versions: several hooks on the same body, in 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1. Every figure matches the source exactly, never rounded.

* Follow each brand’s style and rules exactly, including legal disclaimers. Check every piece against our quality checklist before you deliver it.

* Deliver on the agreed day, every time, with the project files in our shared Drive. Revisions within 24 hours.



What You Would Do: Research and Ideas

* Every week: a short, sourced note on what is working in our market and our clients’ markets (Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, competitors, trends that fit the brand), plus your ideas for our own channels.

* For every client ad brief: two or three hook or concept options, backed by what you found. We pick one, and you make it.

* Keep a one-page platform sheet (length, hook timing, safe zones, captions for each channel), and tell us before you edit if a brief will not work on a platform.

* Tell us when something is wrong, including when it is our mistake.



How We Work

* Ownership. You communicate early, deliver on time, and hold a high bar without being chased.

* We are warm with each other and with our clients. People first, then the task.

* We want you to disagree with us, including with the founder, when you think we are wrong. Say it kindly and say it early.

* We check before we claim. If you are not sure something is right, say so.



Real, Not Generated

Everything we make must look real, authentic and worth stopping for. For our own brand: no AI-generated images, AI voices or AI avatars, ever. For client work you follow each client’s standard: real footage and real people always, with AI voice-over or AI versioning tools where the client uses them. Standard editing tools (auto-captions, noise removal, colour correction) are fine everywhere.



What You Get From Us

Raw footage or scripts, a short brief for each piece, brand guides, templates, a quality checklist and examples of finished work. Every piece has its own card on our board with the brief filled in. You never start without one.



What We Are Looking For

* Senior experience: short-form and ad creative for brands in Australia, Europe, the UK or the US.

* A portfolio of short-form ad or talking-head videos, and static social or ad designs. Work that looks premium and real, not flashy or templated.

* You notice what works and why, and you say so before you are asked.

* Obsessive attention to detail. We notice a wrong figure or a typo, and so should you.

* Fast, reliable turnaround and clear written English.



Room To Grow

We want someone for the long term.

* Phase one: our own content and product ads.

* Phase two, once quality and deadlines hold: client work and more responsibility.

* After that: running our production board and quality checks.



Your rate is reviewed at each step. What you will not own is strategy: we or the client d
 what to make. You make the decision better, and the work excellent.



How We Hire

A short paid test, US$25: one 30-second video from our raw footage, exported for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts with two lines on what you changed and why, plus one static post from our template.



The strongest two or three then get a second paid test, US$75: a short research note on ads in a European consumer-finance market, three concept options, and one 20-second ad made from a script and stock footage, with a voice-over placed and a legal disclaimer set exactly.



We pay for all of it either way, and we will tell you how you did. Your first month is a trial for both of us. Before you start, you sign a short contractor agreement covering confidentiality, that the work you make for us is ours, and that client work is done under our name, from our
 address.



How To Apply

Please start your message with the word “margin”, so we know you have read this. Then answer four questions:

1. Send links to two or three short-form videos and two or three static designs you made, and tell us which tools you use. Which of them were for brands in Australia, Europe, the UK or the US, and what result did they get?

2. What is your monthly rate in US dollars for about 20 hours a week? And your hourly rate, for reference.

3. Pick one ad or short video from an Australian, European or US brand that you think works. Send the link, tell us why it works in two or three sentences, and what you would test next.

4. Tell us about a time you delivered under a tight deadline, or caught a mistake before it went out. What happened?



Keep it short. Good work and honest answers tell us more than a long application.

title: NOW HIRING: ELITE COLD CALLER / SALES CLOSER – U.S. BUSINESSES  Company: Quiet Growth Systems Position: Cold Caller / Sa
description:
Company: Quiet Growth Systems

Position: Cold Caller / Sales Closer

Hours: Approximately 20 hours per week

Schedule: U.S. Eastern Time business hours

Starting Pay: $5 per hour + $20 per closed, paying customer



WE ARE LOOKING FOR A TOP-PERFORMING SALES CLOSER!



Quiet Growth Systems is looking for an exceptional, experienced cold caller who is also a proven sales closer.



We are NOT looking for someone who only sets appointments. We want someone who knows how to SELL and CLOSE DEALS.



You will contact U.S. business owners and sell our AI (Artificial Intelligence) Receptionist service, which helps businesses answer missed calls, capture leads, schedule appointments, and generate more revenue.



You must be confident, persuasive, professional, and capable of turning cold prospects into paying customers.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Make outbound cold calls to U.S. business owners.

- Get past gatekeepers and speak directly with decision-makers.

- Quickly identify business problems and buying opportunities.

- Explain the value of our AI Receptionist in a compelling way.

- Handle objections confidently, including price, timing, and lack of interest.

- Ask for the sale and close customers.

- Follow up with interested prospects until a buying decision is made.

- Coordinate closed sales for secure payment processing.

- Track daily calls, conversations, qualified prospects, and completed sales.

- Work independently during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Proven experience in cold calling AND closing sales.

- Demonstrated success selling directly to U.S. customers or business owners.

- Excellent spoken English and strong communication skills.

- Confident handling objections and asking for payment commitments.

- Strong persuasion, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

- Experience using calling software and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems.

- A proven record of closing paying customers—not just booking appointments.



COMPENSATION



$5 per hour to start, approximately 20 hours weekly.



PLUS a $50 + bonus for every customer you personally originate and close who becomes a paying customer.



This is a performance-driven position. We value actual sales results, not just the number of calls made.



TO APPLY, ANSWER ALL OF THESE QUESTIONS



1. How many years of cold-calling and sales-closing experience do you have?

2. Have you sold products or services directly to U.S. business owners? What did you sell?

3. How many paying customers have you personally closed in your best month?

4. What was your average closing percentage? Explain how you calculated it.

5. Approximately how many outbound calls did you make per day?

6. What is your strongest technique for overcoming objections and closing a hesitant prospect?

7. What calling software, power dialers, and CRM systems have you used?

8. Are you available for approximately 20 hours weekly during U.S. Eastern Time?



VOICE RECORDING REQUIRED



Submit a 60–90 second voice recording pretending you are cold-calling the owner of a roofing company.



Your goal is to:



- Get the owner's attention immediately.

- Explain how our AI Receptionist can help the business make more money.

- Handle an objection such as "I'm not interested" or "It's too expensive."

- Demonstrate how you would ask for the sale and CLOSE THE DEAL—not merely book an appointment.



We are evaluating your spoken English, confidence, persuasion, objection handling, and ability to close.



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTION



Put the word EAGLE in the subject line of your application.



Applications without EAGLE will not be considered.



If you are an average appointment setter, this position is not for you. If you are an outstanding closer who consistently produces sales, we want to hear from you.

title: AI Content & Video Production Specialist
description:
PhenomenalM | Remote | AI-First Creative Role



One brilliant idea. A thousand pieces of extraordinary content. Almost unlimited reach.



We're looking for an exceptional **AI Content & Video Production Specialist** who knows how to turn a founder's voice, ideas, and long-form content into a powerful, scalable content machine.



Not just someone who edits videos.



Someone who understands how to multiply creative output using AI, automation, and exceptional storytelling.



At 
, we're building a global personal development brand dedicated to helping people transform their identity and create extraordinary realities. Check out our founder page at 
/by.dzanella.



We have the ideas. We have the intellectual property. We have the content.



Now we want someone who can turn that into an unstoppable distribution engine.



You know how to take one incredible 60-minute conversation and transform it into dozens of compelling videos, hundreds of variations, and an ongoing stream of content across multiple platforms.



And you don't intend to do all of that manually.



You build systems. You use AI. You create digital employees. You automate workflows. And you know that technology should amplify exceptional creativity, never replace it.



What you'll own



1. Turn existing content into an endless content engine.



- Transform long-form videos, podcasts, masterclasses, and trainings into high-impact short-form content.

- Identify the most powerful hooks, insights, emotional moments, and shareable ideas.

- Create compelling, platform-native videos for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other channels.

- Repurpose winning content into multiple formats, hooks, lengths, and creative variations.

- Build a searchable, organized content library that makes our existing intellectual property continuously reusable.



2. Master AI-powered video production.



- Use advanced AI video, voice cloning, lip-syncing, and editing tools to produce realistic, premium-quality content.

- Create authorized AI-generated videos featuring our founder's likeness and voice while maintaining brand authenticity.

- Combine original footage, AI-generated visuals, motion graphics, captions, and audio into compelling content.

- Experiment with emerging AI video tools to push the boundaries of what's possible.

- Ensure every piece of content feels unmistakably on-brand, visually beautiful, and emotionally powerful.



3. Build the automation machine behind the content.



We don't want to hire ten editors to do what one brilliant operator with AI can orchestrate.



- Build automated workflows that take content from raw footage to published assets.

- Develop AI agents and digital employees to assist with identifying clips, writing hooks, editing, captioning, categorizing, and scheduling.

- Connect multiple platforms through tools like n8n, Make, Zapier, and APIs.

- Create systems that distribute and adapt content across channels with minimal manual intervention.

- Continually improve speed, output, and quality without sacrificing brand standards.



4. Think like a growth-minded creative strategist.



- Understand what makes someone stop scrolling, watch, share, save, and take action.

- Create multiple hook and creative variations to test what resonates.

- Analyze performance data to identify what works and produce more of it.

- Build repeatable formats that strengthen our founder's authority and expand our audience.

- Stay ahead of emerging AI creative tools and opportunities.



You'll thrive here if…



- You're **obsessed with AI** and constantly exploring what's possible.

- You have an exceptional eye for video storytelling, pacing, design, and aesthetics.

- You're already experimenting with voice cloning, generative video, avatars, or AI agents.

- You understand the difference between a video that simply communicates information and one that makes people feel something.

- You know how to create content that feels premium and authentic, not like generic AI-generated material.

- You think in systems, not isolated tasks.

- You're highly independent, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out.

- You move fast, test ideas, learn from results, and keep improving.



Tools we'd love you to know



You don't need experience with every tool, but you should be highly proficient in several and confident learning others.



- AI video & voice: 
dio, HeyGen, Runway, Kling, Veo, or similar.

- Video editing & clipping: CapCut, Descript, Premiere Pro, OpusClip, or similar.

- Automation & AI agents: n8n, Make, Zapier, Claude, ChatGPT, or custom AI workflows.

- Content distribution: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and scheduling platforms.

- Analytics: Content performance dashboards, testing systems, and reporting tools.



This probably isn't for you if…



- You only know how to manually edit videos.

- You're waiting for someone to hand you every clip, script, and instruction.

- You think posting more content automatically means better results.

- Your AI-generated content looks artificial, inconsistent, or generic.

- You're uncomfortable experimenting with new tools every week.

- You focus on how many hours something takes rather than how much value it creates.



What winning looks like



Imagine taking one 60-minute founder training and turning it into:



- 100 exceptional short-form videos.

- Dozens of tested hooks and creative variations.

- Platform-specific versions for multiple channels.

- A library of evergreen content ready to be rediscovered and republished.

- An automated workflow that makes the next 60-minute training even easier to multiply.



And then imagine doing that consistently, while learning which content actually attracts the right audience and converts attention into growth.



That's the machine we want you to help us build.



Our goal isn't to publish thousands of mediocre videos.



**It's to create thousands of opportunities for the right people to discover a message that changes their lives.**



The details



- Location: Fully remote

- Hours: Flexible, results-oriented

- Language: Fluent written and spoken English

- Compensation: Based on experience, technical capabilities, and portfolio

- Start: ASAP



How to apply



We care far more about what you can create than what your resume says.

title: Sales and Office Manager (Full-Time, 40–50 hrs/week)
description:
We're a managed services business. We hire full-time Filipino professionals who work with our American small business clients. Finch Harbor employs you and pays you.



This seat is the sales and office manager for a window-cleaning company in the United States. You run its sales and you run its office: you close the customers who ask for a quote, bring back customers who have stopped booking, and manage the office staff who schedule and serve them.



The company has been in business for 13 years, and this is a long term position.



You must meet sales, revenue and other metrics.



What you'll do

- Take over the warm leads: follow up quickly, and raise the share of quotes that turn into booked jobs.

- Win back past customers who stopped booking. Call them, find out why they left, and get them back.

- Move customers onto recurring service, and make sure the office team uses the scripts that do it.

- Manage the two office staff in their current jobs, and keep their hours within their schedule.

- Make sure the office checks every day that crews are on site when they clock in, and get the field crews to follow what the office asks of them.



Requirements

We only review applications that meet every requirement.



- Really clear spoken English, and written English that is correct and easy to read

- Comfort working with people directly, including on the phone

- You have worked for a small business that does in-person work, in the US or the Philippines

- You have sold to customers yourself and closed the sale

- You have managed a team of at least 5 people (management in a call center or BPO alone does not count)



What the job involves

- 40 to 50 hours a week, US business hours, Monday to Friday

- Your own laptop, reliable internet, a quiet place to work, and a high-quality microphone (including during the screening process)

- Background check at offer



Preferred

- A business degree

- You have worked as a leader in a US small service business

- You have built, checked or improved a sales process: how a business gets leads and closes them

- You have used numbers and reports to find and fix problems in a business

- You use AI tools in your daily work



What we offer

- A salary of $1,500 to $2,000 a month depending on experience, paid weekly

- A target bonus of 25% of your salary, up to 35%, based on the client business's profit. The previous manager met the target.

- 10 days of paid time off a year, plus paid US holidays



How hiring works

You must pass each step to move on to the next.



1. Voice introduction. A short spoken answer to one question, recorded on your phone.

2. Practical test, 1 hour. You pick a start time that suits you. The task appears at that time, and you have one hour to finish it on your own.

3. Interview with us, about 45 minutes, by video call. We ask every candidate the same questions in the same order, about real things you have done at work.

4. Interview with the client. A video call with the business owner.

title: Inbound Sales Representative — US Software Company (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
About the role



We're a small US software company selling a subscription product to home-service and professional businesses across the United States. We're hiring one person to own inbound sales end to end: respond, qualify, demonstrate, and close.



This is not cold calling. Every prospect has already replied to us. Larger or more complex deals get handed to our senior closer — you'll own everything up to that line.



You'll work directly with the founder. Scripts, qualification criteria, pricing, objection handling and the CRM process are already written and documented.



Who we're looking for



Required:



2+ years in a sales or account executive role for a US or Australian company. Name them in your application; applications without this won't be considered.

Proven closing experience — you've carried a number and hit it

Neutral, US-sounding spoken English. Your prospects listen on mobile phones from trucks and job sites. You need to be understood the first time.

Strong written English for
 follow-up

Comfortable in a CRM, with strict daily logging discipline

Comfortable writing and maintaining process documentation

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, good headset, computer that handles video calls

Able to work US Pacific hours consistently and long term



Nice to have: subscription or software sales; Pipedrive, Calendly, Zoom, Notion; experience selling to contractors, trades, medical, dental, legal or real estate businesses.



What you'll be doing



Selling



Respond to every inbound reply within one business hour during your shift

Qualify against written criteria: decision maker, business size, fit

Run product demonstrations by phone and video using our documented call flow: discovery, live demonstration, recommendation, close

Close entry-plan customers on the call and send the payment link while you're still on the line

Hand larger or more complex deals to the senior closer with a complete written summary and a booked handover call

Collect new-customer setup details and pass them to onboarding

Work a documented follow-up sequence for prospects who go quiet



Records and process



Log every call,
 and demo in the CRM the same day; every open deal carries a dated next step

Maintain a tracker for a limited-availability offer, checking availability before extending it to anyone

Keep our sales playbook current in Notion: objections, rebuttals, follow-up templates, and the call flow itself, updated as you learn what works

Capture the objections and the exact language prospects use, and feed it back so we improve the materials



Weekly



Friday report: replies received, response times, demos booked, demos held, proposals sent, closes, and reasons for losses



Rules of the role



Only verified claims are used on calls. We keep a written list of what may and may not be said, and it's enforced.

No prospect is called on a mobile number without recorded consent.

You follow the documented process rather than inventing your own.

Compensation



$225 USD per week, paid weekly by Wise, plus performance bonuses paid monthly:



$75 for every new customer you close

$10 for every qualified demo booked and held



A solid month brings total earnings to around $1,450 USD, and there's no ceiling on the close bonus.



Reviews: base moves to $275/week at 3 months and $325/week at 6 months, based on close rate, response times, CRM discipline and reliability on shift. Your base won't be reduced.



Bonuses are paid on collected revenue. A close that refunds within the first 30 days isn't counted. A demo pays only if it's held.



This is a long-term role. We're hiring one person to own this seat.



How to apply



Applications that skip any step won't be reviewed.



1. Record a Loom video, 2 to 3 minutes, camera and microphone on. Tell us: your name and the US or Australian companies you've sold for and what you sold; how you handle a prospect who says "it's too expensive"; and why this role interests you. We need to hear you speak — no audio or no camera means rejection.



2. Answer these in writing:



Which US or Australian companies have you worked for, in what role, for how long?

What was your average deal size, and how many deals did you close per month?

Describe a deal you lost and what you'd do differently.

Can you reliably work midnight to 8:00 AM Philippine Time? What's your plan for sustaining that?

What CRM have you used, and how did you keep it clean?

What were you earning in your last role, base and commission?



3. Put the word "Pacific" as the first word of your application.



Shortlisted candidates complete a short paid test project before a final interview.

title: Digital Programs - Operations Specialist
description:
PhenomenalM | Remote | Full Time



You're the person who makes everything run beautifully behind the scenes.



We're looking for a sharp, resourceful, tech-savvy operator who loves creating order, delivering exceptional experiences, and finding smarter ways to get things done.



At 
 we're in the business of extraordinary transformation. Our digital programs and communities help people rewrite what's possible for their lives. Checkout our founder profile here: 



And behind every extraordinary member experience is someone making sure the details are handled exceptionally well.



**That's where you come in.**



This isn't a role for someone who needs a checklist for every task. It's for someone who sees what needs to happen, takes ownership, and figures out the best way to make it happen.



You love getting things done. You care about the details. And when you discover a repetitive task, your first thought is, *"There has to be a smarter way to do this."*



What you'll own



1. Make every member interaction exceptional.



- Own our daily program inboxes (approximately 2 hours per day), responding to questions with clarity, warmth, and professionalism.

- Engage with members through community DMs and comments, ensuring people feel seen, supported, and valued.

- Resolve what you can independently and know when to escalate.

- Spot recurring questions and opportunities to improve the member experience.



2. Keep our digital communities running seamlessly.



- Schedule engaging community posts, announcements, and updates in Mighty Networks.

- Support the behind-the-scenes operations of our digital programs.

- Keep information organized, accurate, and easy to access.

- Jump into miscellaneous operational projects and take them from request to completion.



3. Help us build smarter systems with AI.



We're building a business where AI isn't an afterthought. It's how we operate.



- Find opportunities to eliminate repetitive manual work.

- Experiment with AI tools and automation to improve efficiency.

- Help create dashboards that bring information together from multiple platforms.

- Explore integrations between tools like Mighty Networks, Kajabi, Google Sheets, and other systems.

- Bring solutions to the table, not just problems.



You don't need to know how to build everything  with AI today. You do need to be the kind of person who gets excited about figuring it out.



You'll thrive here if…



- You're ridiculously organized and genuinely enjoy the details.

- You communicate beautifully in written English.

- You're proactive. You don't wait to be told what to do when you can see what needs to happen.

- You're resourceful. Google, ChatGPT, Claude, and Instagram are part of your problem-solving toolkit.

- You take pride in delivering work that's accurate, polished, and complete.

- You're comfortable juggling daily responsibilities while improving the systems behind them.

- You're the person who says "I've already figured it out" rather than "I wasn't sure what to do."



Experience with digital programs, online communities, customer support, Mighty Networks, Kajabi, or automation tools is a major plus.



This probably isn't for you if…



- You need detailed instructions for every small decision.

- You prefer doing things the same way simply because that's how they've always been done.

- You struggle to communicate clearly or follow through.

- You're uncomfortable learning new technology.

- You consider a task complete without checking whether the desired result was achieved.



What winning looks like



Members receive an incredible experience. Questions don't sit unanswered. Community content goes out as planned. Details don't fall through the cracks.



And every month, you've helped us make at least one thing simpler, faster, or better.



Your impact isn't measured by how busy you are. It's measured by how well things run because you're here.



The details



- Location: Fully remote

- Hours: Full-time, with consistent daily availability

- Language: Fluent written and spoken English

- Compensation: Fixed monthly fee based on experience

- Start: ASAP



Ready to join us?



We don't need a perfect resume. We want to see how you think.



Along with your resume, tell us:



1. What's one example of a process you've improved, automated, or made more efficient?

2. If we gave you access to five different platforms and asked you to create one dashboard showing the most important information, how would you approach it?

3. What AI tools do you currently use, and what's the most impressive thing you've done with them?

4. What is your desired monthly compensation?



If you're the kind of person who makes things happen, makes things better, and makes everyone around you wonder how they ever operated without you, we want to meet you.

Required Skills & Experience:

Nice to Have:

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Business Development Representative (Philippines) | Fully Remote



Aria Properties is hiring a fully remote Business Development Representative in the Philippines to turn skip-traced property owner leads into booked meetings and signed management contracts. Pay is $500 a month base plus bonuses, $675 at target, Monday to Friday on a US Eastern schedule.



About Aria Properties



Aria Properties is a boutique, full-service property management, revenue management and real estate investment company. We do not want to be the biggest operator in the market. We want to manage high-quality properties that owners are proud of and guests love, with low turnover and lean systems.



This is our dedicated business development hire. You will work a list of skip-traced property owner leads, turn cold contacts into real conversations, and book meetings that lead to new management and revenue management contracts, starting in the Pocono Mountains market and expanding into other markets.



What you’ll do



You own the path from cold contact to booked meeting, and you hand a well-prepared prospect to the Aria team.



Qualify each lead before any outreach: self-managed or already using a manager, property type and rate range, location, and visible pain signals such as dated photos, an uneven booking calendar or no direct-booking presence.

Sort leads into priority tiers and give the best-fit owners the full outreach sequence.

Run a structured, multi-touch sequence across text, phone and
. Every touch has one goal: a short conversation, not a pitch.

Personalize each message around something real about the owner’s property, so outreach never reads as a blast.

Prepare for every meeting with comparable-property data and a revenue gap view, so the owner sees what better management or pricing could mean for them.

Pitch two offers: full property management, and stand-alone revenue management (pricing) for owners who want to keep self-managing.

Track your own numbers (dials, conversations, meetings set, contracts signed) and keep the CRM current the same day.

Report weekly on what is working and what to adjust.

Build relationships in owner communities: join and actively take part in short-term rental investor and owner groups on
 and WhatsApp. Observe and learn what owners ask about and struggle with, then add real value with helpful advice on behalf of Aria Properties. The goal is long-term relationships that lead owners to switch to our management or to our pricing service.

Our quality standard



Three quality contracts matter more to us than ten average ones. A good-fit property has:



Thoughtful design and well-chosen furnishings

Strong amenities guests actively look for

Privacy, such as a secluded lot or space away from neighbors

A real connection to nature, such as woods, water, views or mountain surroundings

You will be trained on what a strong property looks like, with examples from our current portfolio. If a lead does not fit this standard, you note it and move on.



Pay and bonuses



Base pay is $500 per month in US dollars, guaranteed. Bonuses are earned on top, so a strong month reaches $675.



Each quality property management contract signed: $50

5 revenue management clients signed: $25

10 revenue management clients signed: $50

Example: 3 quality management contracts ($150) plus 5 revenue management clients ($25) on a $500 base is $675 for the month.



A contract counts when the owner signs and the property meets our quality standard. Bonuses are paid monthly with base pay.



What success looks like



Day 30: 3 quality property management contracts signed from the lead list

Day 60: 20 or more qualified owners actively moving through outreach, with weekly numbers reported

Day 90: A steady weekly outreach routine that runs without daily direction, a fully current CRM, and a consistent flow of booked meetings

Who we’re looking for



We hire for traits that predict success in this work, and we will train you on our market and tools.



Coachable: you take feedback and visibly adjust.

Curious: you ask real questions about an owner’s situation before you talk.

A record of follow-through: in sales, hospitality, real estate, customer service or anywhere else.

Consistent: you do the daily outreach whether or not you feel like it.

Resilient: a brush-off does not derail your day.

Experience in short-term rentals, real estate, hotels, hospitality or phone-based sales is a strong plus. You need excellent spoken and written English, comfort with phone calls, and a reliable computer and internet connection.



Schedule and location



Fully remote, Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. US Eastern time (some days may run to 6 p.m.). That is 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. in the Philippines while US daylight saving time is in effect, and one hour later the rest of the year. Please apply only if a night schedule already works for you.



How to apply



Send two things:



Your detailed CV or resume, clearly showing your education (school, degree, dates) and your work experience (employer, title, dates, what you did and achieved).

A Loom video of under 7 minutes, unedited, covering the points below in order:

Introduce yourself and briefly walk us through your education and work experience.

What has been your most rewarding professional experience so far, and why?

What has been your most challenging professional experience so far, and how did you handle it?

Why do you want to work in business development and relationship building?

Why do you want to work in hospitality and real estate, and/or for Aria Properties?

Describe something you have sold or represented, as if to someone hearing about it for the first time.

Tell us about a time you kept a client or customer happy over a long period.

We review the video for clear English, warmth and composure, because you will speak with property owners and existing clients every day. Applications without a CV and a video will not be considered.



Please upload your CV and Loom video link using this form: 



Thanks,
