Integrate AI tools with Shopify, Google Sheets, Slack, and other platforms.



Automate task assignments, reporting, data collection, and operational workflows.



Build systems to track team productivity and task completion.



Continuously improve processes to reduce errors and save time.



Requirements:



Strong experience with AI automation tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, and AI agents.



Experience with process management and workflow optimization.



Ability to integrate APIs and connect multiple platforms.



Understanding of e-commerce operations, preferably Shopify.



Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.



Experience building automated workflows from scratch.



What we're looking for:



Someone who doesn't just manage tasks but knows how to eliminate unnecessary manual work through AI and automation.



Our goal is to build a business where repetitive operations are automated, allowing our team to focus on higher-value activities.



To apply, please send:



Examples of AI automations you've built.



Tools and platforms you're experienced with.



Your experience managing and optimizing business processes.



Your expected rate.



An example of a business process you've successfully automated.



Only apply if you have real experience building AI-powered automation systems.

title: Inbound Lead Response & Appointment Setter
description:
Remote | Warm Inbound Leads | Account-Based Compensation



Benefits Include:

- Paid 13th Month

- 1 paid PTO day earned per month

- Paid PH holidays

- Paid birthday off

- Work anniversary PTO bonus

- SSS contribution after one year

- Pag-IBIG contribution after one year

- Paid weekly via Wise

- We cover the Wise fees

- 100% remote

- Flexible working environment

- Software and tools provided

- Training, scripts, and client information provided

- Opportunities for increased compensation as additional client accounts are assigned

- Opportunities for bonuses based on performance

- Opportunity to grow into a larger lead-response, sales, or appointment-setting role as Murray Marketing Services expands



Because this role requires ongoing lead coverage, PTO and holidays will be coordinated in advance so we can arrange backup coverage.



Your normal account-based compensation will not be reduced simply because you use approved PTO.



About Murray Marketing Services



Murray Marketing Services is a growing U.S.-based digital marketing agency founded in 2021 and headquartered in Knoxville, Tennessee.



We partner primarily with service-based businesses throughout the United States and help them grow through Google Ads, Meta Ads, website design, landing pages, SEO, CRM and automation, organic social media, and other digital marketing strategies.



Our team is fully remote.



We're launching a new service designed to help our clients convert more of the leads we're already generating for them, and we're looking for an Inbound Lead Response & Appointment Setter to help us build and grow this service.



This is an important position because speed matters.

When someone fills out a lead form requesting information from one of our clients, we don't want that lead sitting untouched for hours or days.

We want someone calling them within minutes.



Why Join Murray Marketing Services?



We're looking for someone who wants more than a temporary freelance project. We want to build a long-term relationship with someone who can grow alongside the company.



About the Role



This is NOT traditional cold calling.

The majority of people you contact will have already:

- Seen one of our clients' advertisements

- Filled out a website or landing-page form

- Requested information

- Asked for a quote

- Requested an estimate

- Asked to schedule an appointment

- Otherwise expressed interest in the client's services



Your job is to contact them quickly, have a real conversation, determine what they need, and help move them toward the next step.



Depending on the client, that may mean:

Booking the appointment directly, or

Qualifying the lead and providing the client with a detailed handoff.



For example, if someone fills out a form requesting a roofing estimate, you may call them, confirm what type of project they need help with, collect additional information, and schedule an estimate.



For another client, scheduling may be more complicated. In that case, you may qualify the prospect, gather the necessary information, and let the client's team complete the scheduling.



Core Responsibilities



Rapid Lead Response

- Receive immediate notifications when new leads arrive

- Attempt to call new leads as quickly as possible

- Our goal is for new leads to receive their first call attempt within 5 minutes whenever possible

- Respond even faster when circumstances allow

- Make sure leads do not sit untouched

- Prioritize newly submitted leads over older follow-up activity



Speed to lead is one of the most important responsibilities of this position.



Lead Qualification

- Speak with prospective customers professionally and conversationally

- Follow client-specific qualification questions

- Determine what service the prospect is interested in

- Gather relevant information about their needs

- Confirm location/service area when necessary

- Identify obvious unqualified or spam leads

- Record clear notes for each conversation



You will receive information and training for each business you represent.



You are not expected to magically know every client's industry on Day 1.



Appointment Setting



Whenever the client's process allows it:

- Schedule appointments directly

- Schedule estimates or consultations

- Use the client's approved calendar

- Confirm appointment information with the prospect

- Make sure all required details are entered accurately

- Send approved appointment confirmations when applicable



Our preferred outcome is to move a qualified lead all the way to a scheduled next step whenever possible.



Lead Follow-Up



Calling once is not enough.



You will be responsible for following an approved follow-up process for leads that don't initially answer.



This may include:

- Multiple call attempts

- SMS messages

- Voi
s

- Follow-up on different days/times

- Updating the lead status after each attempt



You must be comfortable being persistent without being annoying or unprofessional.



CRM Management



Most leads will be managed through GoHighLevel.



You will:

- Update lead statuses

- Record call outcomes

- Add detailed notes

- Record qualification information

- Update appointment status

- Complete assigned follow-up tasks

- Keep the CRM clean and organized

- Make it easy for our team and clients to understand exactly what happened with every lead



Previous GoHighLevel experience is a major plus, but we can train the right person.



Client-Specific Processes



You may eventually work with multiple businesses across different industries.



Each business may have different:

- Services

- Qualification questions

- Service areas

- Pricing expectations

- Scheduling processes

- Calendars

- Scripts

- Common customer questions



We will provide client-specific documentation and training.



Your responsibility is to learn and follow each process carefully while still sounding natural on the phone.



Availability & Coverage



This is an unusual role because lead response speed matters more than traditional scheduled working hours.



You will not necessarily be sitting at your computer continuously for the entire coverage window.



Instead, you must be able to receive lead notifications and respond quickly when a new lead comes in.



Initial Live Coverage Target

Monday-Friday: approximately 8:00 AM-8:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

Saturday: approximately 9:00 AM-5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time



We will initially have limited or automated coverage outside these times.



As the service grows, we expect to hire additional appointment setters so coverage can be divided between multiple people.



Important:

You must have a lifestyle and schedule that realistically allows you to respond to notifications during your agreed coverage window.



This probably is not a good fit if you already work another full-time job during the same hours and would not be able to step away to contact a new lead.



You may have other work or freelance clients, but they cannot interfere with your ability to meet Murray Marketing Services' agreed lead-response expectations.



Expected Lead Volume



We are launching this service gradually.



We expect to begin with only a handful of client accounts and grow from there.



Lead volume will vary significantly between clients, but this is not expected to begin at more than 20 new leads every day.



As additional clients adopt the service and lead volume increases, we will add additional appointment setters rather than expecting one person to manage an unreasonable workload.



Compensation

This position is compensated per active client account rather than by the hour.



Starting Compensation

$150 USD per active client account per month

As more client accounts are assigned to you, your compensation increases.



For example:

- 4 accounts = $600/month

- 5 accounts = $750/month

- 10 accounts = $1,500/month

- 15 accounts = $2,250/month

- 18 accounts = $2,700/month



We expect to begin with a smaller number of accounts and expand as more of our clients adopt the service.



Minimum Compensation



Once you have completed training and begin providing live lead coverage, we will provide a minimum compensation of $600/month, even if fewer than four active accounts are initially assigned.



As soon as your account-based compensation exceeds $600, you will be compensated based on your actual assigned accounts.



Compensation is calculated based on your assigned accounts.



Performance Bonuses



Additional bonuses may be offered based on factors such as:

- Fast average lead response times

- Strong contact rates

- Appointment booking rates

- Accurate CRM management

- Reliability

- Client results

- Overall performance



What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate has:

- Excellent spoken English

- A clear and easily understood speaking voice

- Strong conversational skills

- Confidence speaking with U.S.-based consumers

- Previous appointment-setting, sales, call-center, customer-service, receptionist, or phone-support experience

- Strong listening skills

- Ability to ask good follow-up questions

- Ability to follow scripts without sounding robotic

- Professional phone etiquette

- Strong attention to detail

- Persistence

- Reliability

- Ability to work independently

- Strong written English

- Comfort using technology and CRM software

- Reliable internet connection

- Reliable computer

- Reliable headset/microphone

- A quiet environment for phone calls

- Reliable mobile notifications so new leads are not missed



Previous Experience We'd Love to See



Any of the following would be valuable:

- Appointment setting

- Inbound sales

- Lead qualification

- Customer service

- Call center work

- Inside sales

- Receptionist/front-desk work

- Medical appointment scheduling

- Home-service appointment setting

- GoHighLevel

- HubSpot

- Salesforce

- Other CRM platforms

- U.S.-based customer communication



You do not need experience in every category.



The Right Personality



We are looking for someone who is:



Friendly

Prospects should feel like they're speaking with a real person who wants to help them.



Confident

You need to be comfortable guiding a conversation and asking for the appointment.



Persistent

Many leads will not answer the first call.

That doesn't mean we give up.



Organized

You may eventually be handling leads for several different businesses at once.



Fast

A lead that comes in now should not receive a call four hours from now because you forgot about the notification.



Resourceful

If something doesn't make sense, investigate it, check the client documentation, use available resources, and ask intelligent questions.



Trustworthy

You will have access to client leads, customer information, phone numbers, calendars, and CRM systems. We need someone who takes that responsibility seriously.



What Success Looks Like



We will track performance using metrics such as:



Speed to Lead

How quickly are new leads receiving their first contact attempt?



Our target is generally within 5 minutes during coverage hours.



Contact Rate

What percentage of leads are we actually speaking with?



Qualification Rate

How many leads are legitimate prospects who need the client's service?



Appointment Booking Rate

When scheduling is available, what percentage of qualified leads are successfully booked?



Follow-Up Completion

Are leads receiving the required follow-up attempts?



CRM Accuracy

Can anyone reviewing the CRM immediately understand what happened with each lead?



Reliability

Are lead notifications consistently being handled quickly?



We care about results, not just artificially increasing the number of phone calls made.



Tools You'll Use



Depending on the client, tools may include:

- GoHighLevel

- Calling software

- SMS

- Google Workspace

- Google Calendar

- Client scheduling platforms

- Google Sheets

- Asana

- Internal SOPs and training videos



Murray Marketing Services will provide access to the software required for the role.



Training



We will provide:

- Company onboarding

- GoHighLevel training where necessary

- Client-specific information

- Scripts

- Qualification questions

- Scheduling instructions

- Follow-up processes

- Training videos

- SOPs

- Examples of good calls and conversations as the program develops



However, we are looking for someone who already feels comfortable speaking with customers on the phone.



We can teach you our process.



We cannot teach someone to enjoy talking to people.



Independent Contractor Position



This position is offered on an independent contractor basis.



Compensation is based primarily on the number of active client accounts assigned rather than traditional hourly employment.



The contractor is responsible for their own taxes and legal obligations applicable to independent-contractor income.



How to Apply



Please submit:

1. Your resume

2. A brief introduction about yourself

3. Your previous experience with appointment setting, sales, customer service, or phone-based work

4. Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time

5. Any experience you have with GoHighLevel or another CRM

6. Details about any current jobs or clients you work with and the hours associated with them



Required Voice Recording

Please include a 60-90 second Loom recording answering:



"Please introduce yourself, tell us about your experience speaking with customers or leads, and explain why you think you'd be a strong fit for this position."



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



Because this position is almost entirely phone-based, communication quality is one of the most important factors in our hiring decision.

title: Procurement, Proposal & Business Development Specialist (SAM.gov, SAP Ariba)
description:
ABOUT WOUESSI

Wouessi is a technology services company with offices in Toronto, Canada and Manassas, Virginia, offering software, AI, cloud and web development services. We are building our government and corporate sales pipeline. We have submitted government proposals and are working toward our first government contract award. You will work directly with our Founder and CEO.



HOW YOUR TIME SPLITS

About 60% procurement and proposals, 40% business development. This is not a tender-only role: we need you to open doors and grow the pipeline beyond public tenders.



YOUR PRIORITIES

1. Proposals: review RFPs and RFQs, build compliance matrices, draft responses with AI, track amendments and Q&A deadlines.

2. Qualify opportunities: find IT opportunities under USD 100K on government and corporate portals, check eligibility, write a short bid/no-bid recommendation.

3. Supplier profiles: audit Wouessi's profiles, track renewal dates, prepare updates for approval.

4. Business development:

- Run targeted outreach campaigns 
 and LinkedIn) to municipalities, nonprofits, mid-size companies and IT prime contractors, using approved messaging

- Build teaming and subcontracting relationships with primes that already hold government contracts

- Follow up on every lead, past contact and proposal until there is a clear yes or no

- Identify events, supplier-diversity programs and partner networks where Wouessi should show up, and prepare the CEO for them

- Book qualified meetings for the CEO and prepare a short brief before each one

5. Pipeline: keep the CRM current and send a short daily update.

When a deadline is close, proposals come first. We never trade quality for volume.



PLATFORMS


, SAP Ariba, CanadaBuys, MERX, Bonfire, bids&tenders, eVA, UNGM and corporate supplier portals. Experience with 
 or SAP Ariba is a strong advantage. You do not need to know every platform: you will learn the ones you need during onboarding. A teammate already scans tenders daily; you source additional opportunities and own the proposals for the ones you find.



HOW DECISIONS WORK

The CEO d
 whether to bid and approves every submission in writing. You submit only where the platform allows delegated access; otherwise the CEO submits.



TARGETS (cumulative)

Day 30: 8 opportunities qualified, 2 proposals submitted, 60 prospects researched, 1 outreach campaign launched, 2 prime or partner conversations opened, 1 qualified meeting held, supplier profiles audited

Day 60: 16 qualified, 5 proposals, 120 prospects, 2 campaigns, 5 prime/partner conversations, 3 qualified meetings held

Day 90: 24 qualified, 8 proposals, 180 prospects, 3 campaigns, 8 prime/partner conversations, 6 qualified meetings held



WEEKLY RHYTHM (after month one)

- 1 proposal submitted, when there is a suitable opportunity

- 3 opportunities qualified

- 75 personalized outreach touches

- All open leads followed up

- 1 new prime or partner contact



These are planning targets. Contract awards are not a condition of the trial. A qualified meeting = held with a decision-maker, about a documented need, recorded in the CRM. Success at Day 90 = at least one proposal reaches clarification, shortlist or documented buyer feedback.



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 1 year in procurement, proposal coordination or B2B sales support

- B2B business development or outbound sales experience, with evidence of meetings or deals you generated

- RFP, RFQ or proposal writing experience

- Experience with at least one procurement platform

- Strong written English (French is a plus)

- Daily use of ChatGPT, Claude or similar, with careful fact-checking

- Reliable laptop, internet and power backup

- Overlap 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Toronto time (Eastern), Monday to Friday (Philippine evening/night)



NON-NEGOTIABLE

- Never invent or exaggerate clients, contracts, certifications, past performance, values or capabilities

- Never upload RFP attachments, client data or company information to unapproved AI tools

- Use only your own named portal accounts; never share passwords

- All outreach uses approved messaging, follows Canadian and US anti-spam rules, and honours every unsubscribe



WHAT WOUESSI PROVIDES

Company
, CRM access, capability statements, proposal templates, our bid/no-bid checklist, named portal access where authorized, and direct access to the CEO with a weekly pipeline review.



ENGAGEMENT AND PAY

- Full-time independent contractor under a written agreement, 40 hours/week

- USD 600/month base, paid monthly

- USD 20 per qualified meeting held, under written criteria

- 10% of collected first-year gross margin on eligible commercial deals you source, under a written commission schedule. Commission on government contracts applies only where legally permitted.

- Paid 30-day initial engagement; continuation based on performance and mutual fit

- Growth path to Proposal Manager or Business Development Manager for the right person



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Start your application with "Wouessi Pipeline", then answer:

1. Which procurement platforms have you used, and what exactly did you do on each?

2. Describe a proposal or RFQ response you prepared, your role, and the outcome (no confidential details).

3. Write a 4-line introduction
 to a city IT manager about website accessibility improvements. Then tell us how you would find and approach 3 IT prime contractors to partner with Wouessi.

4. How do you use AI to draft proposals, and how do you make sure every claim is accurate?

5. Can you work 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Eastern, Monday to Friday?



Shortlisted candidates complete a paid 2-hour assessment on a sample RFQ (not a live bid). Pass mark 80/100; any invented claim fails automatically. You report to Rodrigue (Rod) Fouafou, Founder and CEO.

title: Kajabi Course & Digital Marketing Coordinator
description:
We are an Australian education business in the hair and beauty industry and are currently moving our online education platform from an existing white-label learning management system across to Kajabi.



We are looking for a proactive and organised Kajabi & Digital Marketing Coordinator to initially help us complete the migration and then become an ongoing part of our team, helping manage and grow our online education platform and community.



This is a hands-on execution role. Our Australian team will handle the education, filming, video editing, campaign direction and overall creative strategy. We need someone who can take the assets and direction we provide and efficiently manage the implementation.



Initial Kajabi Migration



Your first major project will be helping us move our existing education platform into Kajabi, including:



Building and formatting courses, modules and lessons in Kajabi

Uploading existing educational content and resources

Migrating existing members/customers into Kajabi

Organising member access, products, offers, tags and course structures

Helping configure email automations and customer journeys

Testing the new platform to ensure everything works correctly

Helping us create a clean, professional member experience



Ongoing Responsibilities



Once the migration is complete, the role will expand into:



Managing and updating our Kajabi platform

Managing and growing the Kajabi community

Uploading new courses, lessons and educational resources

Scheduling and publishing social media content

Creating simple branded graphics using Canva

Writing captions, emails and supporting marketing copy

Repurposing the content/assets provided by our team

SEO optimisation of website, course and educational content

Keyword research and basic SEO reporting

Assisting with Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising

Building and monitoring digital marketing campaigns

 marketing and Kajabi automations

Monitoring analytics and reporting on what is performing

Helping identify opportunities to improve engagement, memberships and course sales



You will NOT be responsible for:



Our team will continue to handle:



Education and course expertise

Filming

Professional video editing

Main promotional videos, teasers and trailers

Overall brand and campaign direction



You will receive finished assets and direction from us and help turn these into organised, consistent marketing and platform activity.



All major content, advertising and campaigns will be approved by our team before publishing.



Who We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



Has previous experience using Kajabi — highly preferred

Understands online courses and membership businesses

Has digital marketing experience

Understands social media management

Has practical SEO knowledge

Has experience with Meta Ads or similar paid advertising

Is comfortable creating graphics in Canva

Has excellent written English

Is highly organised and detail-oriented

Can work independently rather than waiting for instructions on every task

Is comfortable learning our brand and suggesting improvements

Can manage multiple ongoing tasks and deadlines



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of our team, not simply completing the Kajabi migration and leaving.



Hours



Approximately 20 hours per week initially, with flexibility around when the work is completed.



We are based in Australia, so some availability overlapping Australian business hours would be helpful, but you do not need to work Australian hours exclusively.



Salary



USD $7–$9/hour depending on experience.



For the right person, there is opportunity for increased hours, responsibilities and compensation as the business and platform grow.



Important application instruction



I would put this at the very bottom:



To apply, please start your application with the words "KAJABI HEDUCATION" so we know you have read the full job description.



Please also include:



A link or description of a Kajabi platform you have previously worked on.

Your experience migrating courses or memberships between platforms.

Your experience with Meta Ads and SEO.

Your Canva/design experience.

Your desired hourly rate.

How many hours per week you are currently available.

title: Podcast Relationship & Sponsorship Assistant
description:
# Podcast Guest Relations & Sponsorship Development Assistant



**Company:** Unshackled Moms Alliance / Truly Gutsy Parent Coaching



**Location:** Remote



**Position:** Part-Time, Long-Term



**Hours:** 3–5 hours per week initially, with potential for additional hours as the podcast grows



**Compensation:** $5.50–$7.00 USD per hour, depending on experience, plus sponsorship commissions



**Start Date:** November 2026



## About Us



Unshackled Moms Alliance is a growing podcast dedicated to honest, meaningful conversations about the experiences that shape our lives.



Our interviews explore relationships, family dynamics, grief, personal growth, faith, emotional baggage, overcoming adversity, and finding the courage to move forward.



Our philosophy is simple: **There is always room at our table.**



We believe every person has a story worth hearing, and we are committed to creating conversations that help people feel seen, valued, encouraged, and empowered.



We are looking for a proactive, organized, and relationship-focused Virtual Assistant to help expand our podcast through guest development and sponsorship outreach.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, researching interesting people and organizations, and contributing to the growth of a purpose-driven business.



## Key Responsibilities



### Podcast Guest Relations



- Research and identify compelling podcast guests whose experiences align with our mission and audience.

- Evaluate potential guests for credibility, relevance, and audience value.

- Prepare thoughtful, personalized guest invitations.

- Manage guest communications, scheduling, confirmations, and follow-ups.

- Maintain an organized database of prospective, contacted, scheduled, and completed guests.

- Identify opportunities for guest cross-promotion and audience growth.

- Proactively identify and resolve scheduling or communication issues.



### Sponsorship Development



- Research businesses, brands, and organizations that align with our podcast's audience and values.

- Identify appropriate decision-makers and contact information.

- Prepare personalized sponsorship inquiries and proposals.

- Follow up professionally with potential sponsors.

- Maintain an organized sponsorship pipeline.

- Track conversations, opportunities, agreements, and renewals.

- Coordinate sponsorship details with the podcast host and bookkeeping team.



### Organization and Communication



- Maintain accurate guest and sponsorship tracking systems.

- Provide a concise weekly progress report.

- Communicate regularly with the podcast host and existing operations team.

- Manage assigned responsibilities independently and meet agreed-upon deadlines.

- Identify opportunities for improvement and offer practical recommendations.



## Qualifications



**Required:**



- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong research and communication skills.

- Experience with outreach, lead generation, relationship management, or business development.

- Excellent organization and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple conversations and follow-ups.

- Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision.

- Professional, dependable, proactive, and resourceful.

- Respectful of diverse backgrounds, beliefs, and life experiences.

- Comfortable handling sensitive topics with professionalism and discretion.



**Preferred:**



- Experience with podcast guest booking or podcast management.

- Sponsorship outreach or partnership development experience.

- Experience with CRM software or lead-tracking systems.

- Familiarity with Google Workspace, Google Sheets, HubSpot, or similar tools.

- Experience with podcast scheduling and guest coordination.



We value initiative, sound judgment, and genuine relationship-building more than simply checking tasks off a list.



## Working Hours and Compensation



This position will begin at approximately **3–5 hours per week**, with flexible scheduling.



Some availability for communication during U.S. Pacific business hours is preferred.



We plan to reassess the position's hours and responsibilities after January 1, 2027.



Hourly compensation is $5.50–$7.00 USD, depending on experience.



Additional sponsorship commissions are available:



- **10%** on qualifying sponsorships you originate and develop.

- **5%** on qualifying sponsorships originated by the podcast host that you help nurture and close.

- **5%** on qualifying sponsorship renewals you manage.



Commissions are calculated on sponsorship payments actually received and are subject to a written agreement.



We are seeking someone interested in a long-term professional relationship with opportunities to grow alongside our podcast.



## What to Expect During Our Selection Process



Qualified applicants will be evaluated based on relevant experience, communication skills, initiative, and their ability to build meaningful professional relationships.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to participate in an interview and complete a brief, paid practical assessment involving podcast guest research or sponsorship outreach.



## Application Questions



Please begin your application response with the words **"I read the whole post."**



Then answer the following questions:



1. Tell us about your experience with podcast guest management, outreach, lead generation, sponsorships, sales, or relationship management.



2. If you
ed a potential podcast sponsor and they did not respond, what would your follow-up process look like?



3. Which part of this position interests you most: guest relationships, sponsorship outreach, or both? Why?



4. Tell us about a time when you had to keep track of several people, projects, or conversations at different stages. How did you stay organized?



5. What hourly rate are you seeking, and how many hours per week are you available?

oCommerce brands

oCommerce owns and operates consumer brands supported by shared teams. We are hiring an experienced Customer Service Manager with an exceptional sense of ownership to lead customer support across our ecommerce portfolio.



You will take responsibility for difficult customer issues through to a confirmed resolution. We need someone who can make thoughtful decisions about refunds, replacements, credits, and other remedies, balancing fairness, customer goodwill, and the impact on our P&L. Use sound judgment to choose fair, proportionate remedies, considering what happened, the customer's circumstances and history, our responsibility, and the cost and effect of the available options.

Make decisions within agreed authority and handle policy exceptions thoughtfully; bring unusual or material cases forward with the facts and a recommended solution.

Lead daily team priorities, coverage, handovers, and accountability, coaching agents to take ownership and exercise good judgment.

Build practical SOPs, response templates, and escalation guidance that support consistent service and appropriate decisions for individual situations.

Monitor service quality, customer satisfaction, backlog, repeat contacts, and the costs of refunds, replacements, credits, and additional shipping.

title: Accountant
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Blue Harbour is a New Zealand and Australian consultancy that delivers modern project controls and AI-driven capital intelligence to our clients. We help the organisations that plan and deliver capital programmes make better decisions, faster.



We are a small team growing quickly, and we want our finances run properly from the start. You will work with our Operations Manager, Karrie Hinola, and our founder, Dave Braendler. You will own the books across New Zealand and, from 2027, Australia, and be the person we ask when a money question comes up.



WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

The core of the role is keeping our accounts accurate and our filings on time, so that the numbers we plan with are the numbers in the bank.



You will keep Xero current, close each month, and prepare and file our New Zealand GST and income tax returns through Xero and myIR. When our Australian entity is set up in 2027, you will take on its GST and BAS as well.



You will also help us keep our budget and forecast model honest as we hire, and advise on paying contractors across New Zealand, Australia and the Philippines. Questions are part of the job. Answering them, routine or not, is covered by the retainer.



REQUIREMENTS

* New Zealand and Australian accounting. Hands-on experience with both: NZ GST, income tax and provisional tax, and Australian GST, BAS and ATO requirements.

* Strong Xero skills. Bank reconciliations, coding, bills, multi-currency and month-end, done cleanly and on time. Xero certification is a plus.

* Filing you can be trusted with. You prepare and lodge returns accurately and before the deadline, and you keep a record of what was filed and when.

* Quick, reliable replies. You answer our questions within one business day and are available for a short call when one is needed.

* Clear communication. You explain the numbers in plain English, so someone without an accounting background can act on what you send.

* You flag problems early. If something looks wrong in the books or a deadline is at risk, we hear it from you first.



EXPERIENCE 

We care most about the clients you have kept in good order.



* Three or more years of bookkeeping or accounting for small businesses

*  At least three overseas client whose books you kept and returns you filed 

*  Month-end closes and simple management reports: a P&L and a cash position

*  Working from a budget or forecast model and explaining the gaps





IDEALLY

*  A degree in accounting or a CPA qualification

*  R&D tax incentive claims in New Zealand or Australia

*  NZ payroll and KiwiSaver

*  Paying contractors across borders and in several currencies



WHY THIS ROLE

*  Set up the finances of a growing business from early on, and shape how they are run

*  Steady, ongoing work across two countries, with a third entity coming

*  A small team that answers your questions quickly too

*  Grow the scope of the role as the business grows



HOW WE HIRE

Send a short note covering overseas clients (ideally Australian or New Zealand)  whose books you have kept in Xero, how long you have worked in Xero, and confirm the retainer range works for you. Shortlisted applicants have a video call, and we speak to two of your current clients. The first month is a trial on our own books. We pay attention to how quickly and clearly you reply along the way, because that is the job.

title: Dental Recruiter
description:
Position Overview

RSMC Services is seeking a highly motivated Offshore Recruiter to support the recruitment of dental professionals for clients across the US. This role is responsible for sourcing, screening, and coordinating candidates, ensuring a strong talent pipeline to meet the staffing needs of dental practices. The ideal candidate has experience in high-volume recruitment, strong communication skills, and proficiency in using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and sourcing tools. This is a fast-paced, performance-driven role that requires excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively with onshore recruiters and hiring managers.



Job Description

• Source, screen, and assess candidates for open positions.

• Utilize various sourcing methods, including job boards, social media, and Boolean searches.

• Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.

• Maintain accurate records in the applicant tracking system (ATS).

• Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for future hiring needs.

• Ensure an excellent candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.

• Collaborate with hiring teams to understand job requirements and deliver top-tier candidates.

• Track and report recruitment metrics for continuous process improvement.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for Onshore Recruiter Manager

1. Sourcing & Candidate Pipeline

• Source and pre-screen qualified dental professionals (Dentists, Hygienists, Assistants, Front Office Staff).

• Maintain a high submission-to-interview ratio, ensuring high-quality candidates are sent to the onshore team.

• Build and maintain a pipeline of active pre-vetted candidates at any given time.

2. Speed & Efficiency

• Maintain a candidate turnaround time of 24-48 hours from sourcing to submission.

• Ensure 100% accuracy in applicant tracking systems (ATS), maintaining complete candidate profiles and documentation.

• Ensure timely coordination between candidates and hiring managers.

3. Placement & Hiring Performance

• Ensure high placement rate for submitted candidates.

• Ensure 80% of placed candidates remain in their roles beyond 90 days, improving retention for onshore clients.

• Reduce time-to-fill vacancies by meeting staffing demands efficiently.

4. Candidate & Client Experience

• Ensure 100% compliance with U.S. hiring policies, US labor laws, and credentialing requirements.

• Provide weekly recruitment reports with clear updates on sourcing, pipeline, and hiring progress.

5. Team Collaboration & Communication

• Maintain a response time of under 2 hours for all recruiter inquiries and hiring team requests.

• Attend and actively participate in weekly recruiter meetings and training sessions to enhance skills and market knowledge.

• Ensure smooth coordination with onshore recruiters, hiring managers, and clients.



Qualifications

• Experience: 2+ years of recruitment experience, preferably in healthcare, dental, or high-volume staffing (Must have healthcare working history)

• Candidate Sourcing: Strong ability to source, screen, and engage candidates using LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, and Boolean searches.

• Recruitment Process Knowledge: Experience managing the full recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing to placement.

• Technology Proficiency: Proficiency in using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), LinkedIn Recruiter, and recruitment CRM tools.

• Communication & Relationship Building: Excellent English communication skills to engage candidates and coordinate with onshore recruiters.

• Data Accuracy & ATS Management: Ability to maintain 100% accuracy in candidate data entry and status updates.

• Speed & Efficiency: Strong ability to meet daily and weekly hiring targets while maintaining high-quality candidate submissions.

• Collaboration & Teamwork: Ability to work effectively in a remote setting, coordinating with offshore and onshore teams.

• Results-Driven: Ability to meet submission, interview, and placement goals in a fast-paced environment.

• Adaptability & Problem-Solving: Ability to handle high-volume hiring needs while ensuring a positive candidate experience.

title: PowerPoint Animation & Video Production Specialist
description:
Engagement Type: Fixed-Price, Project-Based Contract

Payment will be on a monthly basis.

Project Commencement: Targeting Friday onwards, subject to confirmation of project readiness and receipt of required files

Future Opportunities: Potential follow-on projects involving animated presentations and InstaDoodle

1. Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced PowerPoint Animation & Video Production Specialist to transform an existing workshop presentation into a polished, professionally animated, narrated video.

The project involves enhancing an existing presentation of approximately 40 slides, incorporating around 120 graphic and audio elements, and synchronising visual animations with a supplied script and narration.

All core content, scripts, on-screen text, base graphics, and design direction will be provided. The primary responsibility is to execute the technical production, animate individual visual elements, coordinate audio and animation timing, and deliver a high-quality video alongside a fully editable PowerPoint presentation.

The ideal candidate will combine advanced PowerPoint animation skills with strong visual judgement, audio synchronisation capabilities, and meticulous attention to detail. They should be comfortable working independently with supplied assets and translating a written script into a clear, engaging sequence of visual events.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Advanced PowerPoint Animation

Enhance and prepare the supplied PowerPoint presentation for professional video production.

Separate and prepare graphic elements, illustrations, diagrams, and other visual assets where necessary to enable individual animation.

Create sophisticated animation sequences using PowerPoint's Animation Pane, motion paths, layered graphics, entrance and exit effects, and emphasis animations.

Progressively reveal diagrams, illustrations, text, and other visual components in alignment with the narration.

Control animation order, duration, delays, transitions, and sequencing to ensure a logical and engaging presentation flow.

Synchronise individual graphic movements and appearances with specific sections of the script and narration.

Maintain a consistent visual style across the entire presentation, ensuring that animations enhance understanding rather than distract from the content.

Preserve the editability and structure of the final PowerPoint file for future revisions.

B. Narration and Audio Synchronisation

Work with the supplied script, expected to contain approximately 2,000–3,000 words, and coordinate it with the presentation's visual sequence.

Integrate supplied narration or generate AI-based voiceovers if required and agreed as part of the production workflow.

Use AI voice-generation platforms such as ElevenLabs or comparable tools where necessary.

Divide narration into suitable segments to align with individual slides, visual elements, and animation sequences.

Fine-tune audio timing, pauses, animation triggers, and slide transitions to maintain accurate synchronisation.

Review audio clarity, consistency, playback, and transitions throughout the presentation.

C. Video Production and Export

Convert the completed animated presentation into a high-quality MP4 video.

Configure slide timings and playback settings to ensure the video runs smoothly without requiring manual interaction.

Review the exported video for animation errors, audio mismatches, unexpected pauses, clipped elements, inconsistent transitions, and other playback issues.

Make necessary adjustments to ensure the final video meets professional presentation and production standards.

Ensure the final output maintains a consistent pace and provides a clear, engaging viewing experience.

D. Graphic Preparation and Asset Management

Prepare, edit, and organise supplied graphics for use within the presentation.

Separate complex graphics into individual components when required for progressive animation.

Maintain organised source files and separately prepared graphic assets to support future editing and revisions.

Ensure that visual assets remain properly positioned, proportioned, and consistent across slides.

Deliver all agreed source files and assets in an organised, accessible format.

E. Quality Assurance and Project Delivery

Follow the supplied script, design direction, and production instructions accurately.

Conduct a complete review of the presentation and exported video before delivery.

Check animation timing, narration alignment, slide sequencing, visual consistency, and playback quality.

Resolve technical issues and make agreed refinements within the project scope.

Communicate progress, raise potential production challenges early, and manage the project independently to meet the agreed deadline.

Deliver the final files in the agreed formats and ensure they are ready for future editing or reuse.

3. Essential Skills and Experience

Candidates must demonstrate practical experience in the following areas:

Advanced Microsoft PowerPoint

Strong working knowledge of the Animation Pane, custom animations, motion paths, transitions, layered graphics, and detailed timing controls.

Ability to animate individual elements within complex slides rather than relying solely on basic slide transitions.

Ability to build animation sequences that progressively introduce information in a logical order.

Presentation-to-Video Production

Proven experience creating narrated PowerPoint presentations and exporting them successfully as high-quality MP4 videos.

Understanding of slide timings, playback settings, audio integration, and video quality control.

Ability to troubleshoot animation and playback issues during video export.

Audio and Animation Synchronisation

Experience aligning narration with individual slides, diagrams, text, and animated visual elements.

Strong understanding of timing, sequencing, pauses, transitions, and pacing.

Graphic Manipulation

Ability to prepare and separate supplied graphics into individual elements for animation.

Confidence working with layered visuals, diagrams, illustrations, and other presentation assets.

Attention to Detail and Execution

Strong visual judgement and a methodical approach to quality assurance.

Ability to follow a supplied script and design direction precisely.

Comfortable handling detailed, repetitive production work without compromising quality.

Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and deliver within an agreed project scope.

Portfolio Evidence

Candidates must be able to share relevant examples of animated PowerPoint presentations, narrated training materials, explainer videos, or comparable production work.

Candidates should clearly explain their individual contribution to the showcased projects.

4. Preferred Skills and Tools

The following are advantageous but are not mandatory:

Experience with InstaDoodle, Doodly, or similar whiteboard-animation platforms.

Familiarity with AI voice-generation tools such as ElevenLabs or comparable platforms.

Experience with Camtasia, Adobe Premiere Pro, or other video editing and production software.

Background in e-learning, instructional content, online courses, workshop recordings, training videos, or educational presentations.

Experience producing explainer videos or animated presentations involving complex diagrams and progressive visual explanations.

Familiarity with audio editing, narration segmentation, and basic sound quality optimisation.

Important: Advanced PowerPoint animation and successful presentation-to-video production are the primary selection criteria. Candidates should not be rejected solely because they have not used InstaDoodle or Doodly, provided they demonstrate strong transferable animation skills and a willingness to learn.

5. Project Scope and Deliverables

The successful candidate will be responsible for completing the following deliverables:

Editable PowerPoint presentation: A fully editable PPTX file containing the completed animation sequences, transitions, timing, and integrated narration as agreed.

Final MP4 video: A high-quality video export with correctly synchronised narration, animations, and slide transitions.

Prepared graphic assets: All separately prepared graphic components and other agreed assets required to maintain or revise the presentation.

Quality-checked final output: A reviewed presentation and video with no known unresolved issues relating to animation sequencing, audio synchronisation, or playback.

Organised source files: Source materials structured clearly enough to support future editing and updates.

The project is expected to cover approximately 40 slides and 120 graphic/audio elements. The final scope and specific deliverable requirements will be confirmed before production begins.

6. Project Budget and Engagement Conditions

This is a project-based engagement rather than an hourly employment arrangement.

Candidates should review the deliverables and estimated workload carefully before accepting the project.

Any additional work outside the agreed scope must be discussed and approved separately before commencement.

The candidate must be able to commit the time required to complete the project within the agreed timeline and quality expectations.

7. Potential Follow-On Work: InstaDoodle

Following successful completion of the initial project, there may be opportunities for additional work involving InstaDoodle or similar animation platforms.

Future projects may involve animating individual visual elements in accordance with supplied scripts and narration. Prior InstaDoodle experience is beneficial but not essential, as the platform is expected to be relatively straightforward to learn, with initial familiarisation estimated at approximately 30 minutes.

Any follow-on work will be scoped, scheduled, and agreed separately from the initial PowerPoint project. Recurring or part-time work may be considered depending on future project requirements and performance.

8. Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a technically capable animation specialist who enjoys turning static information into clear, engaging visual presentations.

They will:

Have a portfolio demonstrating advanced PowerPoint animation or comparable presentation-based video production.

Be confident creating animations at the individual graphic-element level.

Understand how to translate narration into well-timed visual sequences.

Have successfully exported narrated presentations into polished video formats.

Be detail-oriented, organised, and comfortable working with client-provided materials.

Be able to deliver both editable source files and a professional final video.

Be comfortable working within a fixed project budget and agreed scope.

Be open to learning additional animation tools for potential future projects.

9. Screening and Application Requirements

Interested candidates should provide:

An updated CV highlighting relevant PowerPoint animation and video production experience.

A portfolio or links to at least two relevant examples, where available.

A brief explanation of their role in each example and which tools they used.

Confirmation of their experience exporting animated PowerPoint presentations to MP4.

Details of any experience with AI voice-generation tools and audio synchronisation.

Confirmation of their availability to undertake the initial project and complete up to 50 hours of work.

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to discuss their production workflow, explain how they would approach the animation and narration requirements, and demonstrate relevant work during an interview.

10. Selection Priorities

Candidates will be assessed primarily on:

Demonstrated advanced PowerPoint animation skills.

Proven experience producing narrated presentations and exporting them to MP4.

Ability to synchronise audio with individual visual elements and animation sequences.

Portfolio quality, attention to detail, and understanding of visual pacing.

Ability to deliver editable source files and organised assets.

Availability, commitment to the fixed project scope, and potential suitability for future work.

Experience with a particular whiteboard-animation platform is secondary to proven production ability.

The objective is to identify a reliable, technically strong specialist who can take supplied content and turn it into a polished, fully editable animated presentation and professional narrated video.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours 



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision: 

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business. 



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us! 



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager 



Role Purpose 

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time. 



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events. 



What Success Looks Like 

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance. 



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts. 



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution. 



Primary Objectives 

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System 

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR 

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment 

Competitive Advantage 

 

Regular Work Activities 

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails) 

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking 

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy 

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates 

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track) 

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content) 

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs 

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates 

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates 

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals 

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP) 

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration 

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR 

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required 

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals) 

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement 

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets) 

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing) 

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type) 

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed 

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list) 

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches) 

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues) 

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers) 

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination) 

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests) 



Key Skills 

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth) 

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions) 

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation 

Organized project management across many ASINs 

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating) 

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes 

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops) 

 

People Contacts and Interactions 

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment) 

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes) 

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions) 

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment 



Role Requirements 

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred) 

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent) 

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents) 

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work 

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline 

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back 



How to Apply:

Click the link - 

ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.

title: Operations Coordinator (Scheduling & Customer Support) · ₱40K–50K + 13th Month · Day Shift · Australian Company
description:
₱40,000–50,000/month + 13th month pay · DAY shift, no graveyard · 2 days off in a row · a long-term role with an Australian company that's growing fast.



Apply here (about 20 minutes): 



No cover letter and no long interview loop. A short video application, then a PAID ₱500 practice shift. Everyone who applies hears back from us.



WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH IT



- Pay: ₱40,000–50,000/month based on experience, with a pay review after your 2-month probation, written into your contract

- 13th month pay, paid sick days and paid public holidays

- Day shift: most days 6am–3pm Manila time. No night shift.

- Friday and Saturday off, every week

- Fixed hours in your contract. No surprise schedule changes.

- A small, friendly team that trains you properly and grows its people



ABOUT US



Lee Mathematics Tuition is an online maths tutoring company based in Sydney, Australia. We look after about 280 families and 300 students across Australia, with more than 70 tutors, and we're growing every month. Our operations team is small, and we're adding a coordinator so the desk is properly covered from morning to evening, seven days a week.



WHAT THE JOB REALLY IS



You keep our lessons running. Every week, dozens of lessons need to move: a tutor gets sick, a student has an exam, a parent's schedule changes. You make sure each one lands safely. You find a cover tutor or a new time, update the calendar, and make sure the parent, the student and every tutor involved knows exactly what's happening, in their own time zone.



You also get new families started. When a family signs up, our system suggests tutors who fit. You get those tutors to confirm, agree an exact time with the parent, book the first lesson and make sure it actually happens, usually within 3–4 business days.



You'll work alongside a second coordinator who covers afternoons, evenings and Saturdays. You both learn the whole job and cover each other. Your shift owns the morning side: getting new families to their first lesson, daily account checks and payment follow-ups, and the Sunday and Monday desk on your own.



The honest hard parts:

- People don't always reply. Tutors go quiet, and parents reply at 10pm. You chase, politely, as many times as it takes.

- Australia has several time zones. A Perth parent, a Brisbane tutor and a Sydney calendar can all be part of one lesson. Getting this right every time is non-negotiable.

- Some parents are upset when they call. You stay warm, follow our rules, and never promise what you can't deliver.

- On some shifts you're the only one on. You make the call yourself, using our handbook, and write it down so the next person knows.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Answer parent and tutor messages, calls and
s, usually within 15 minutes

- Move, cover and book lessons in our calendar, and close every loop: old lesson removed, everyone told, times labelled

- Own each new family until their first lesson has happened

- Follow up payments with families (templated messages, with our accounts process behind you)

- Keep each family's record up to date and write a clear handover at the end of your shift



YOU'LL DO WELL HERE IF YOU ARE



- Accurate. Names, dates and times are right the first time. You double-check before you send.

- Someone who closes loops. You don't go quiet. Either "done" or "can't yet, because…, I'll update you by 3pm".

- Persistent and quick. You chase within minutes, and you ask three tutors at once instead of waiting on one.

- A fast learner. When we correct something once, it sticks.

- Warm, clear and confident in English, on the phone and in writing, with Australian parents.

- Good at judgement. You know when to d
 and when to ask.

- Comfortable with software: TutorBird, Asana, Slack, Aircall, Notion, WhatsApp, Gmail. We train you on our setup.



Nice to have: scheduling, dispatch, clinic, logistics or coordinator experience; phone support for Australian or US clients.



HOURS: SUNDAY TO THURSDAY (FRIDAY + SATURDAY OFF)



Manila time (Sydney time in brackets):

- Sunday: 6:30am–3:30pm (Sydney 9:30am–6:30pm)

- Monday: 9am–6pm (Sydney 12pm–9pm)

- Tuesday–Thursday: 6am–3pm (Sydney 9am–6pm)



45 hrs/week. These exact hours go into your contract. Your Sydney hours stay fixed; when Australian daylight saving ends in April, the Manila times move 1 hour later.



HOW TO APPLY: WE HIRE ON SKILL, NOT CVs



Apply here: 

(You can also click Apply on OnlineJobs, but the application at this link is what we review.)



1. Application (about 20 minutes, on a laptop with a camera). Your details and CV, a short "why this role" answer, then a short video interview recorded in your browser: 4 questions out loud (one about you, then 3 real situations from our desk). You get a moment to think before each one, and one re-record per question. It's fine to be a little nervous on camera. We're listening for how you think.

title: Meta Ads Media Buyer for UK Marketing Agency - Home Service Niche
description:
We’re looking for a media buyer who can turn a plumbing and heating company’s ad budget into booked appointments, and show us the numbers to prove it.



You’ll own Meta campaigns for our (plumbing, solar, roofing & home renovation) clients from start to finish: strategy, creative, launch, and optimising. Your ads are the first thing every lead touches.



The role is paid per client, per month. You start with one client account. So do great work and you’ll get more.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Build our clients'
 and Instagram campaigns in Ads Manager: the campaigns, the ad sets and the lead forms.

- Design image ads and edit short video ads

- Pick the angles and offers we test

- Write the ad copy and video scripts

- Track cost per lead, cost per appointment and cost per acquisition

- Kill what isn’t working fast and scale what is

- Send us a short update on results and next steps on a weekly basis



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



- You’ve run Meta campaigns specifically for home-service based businesses (plumbers, solar installers, roofers, kitchen & bathroom renovators, etc) and can screenshare real results

- You’re confident in your ability to run high-converting campaigns at a medium to large sized monthly ad budget (£1,000-£3000/month | $1330-$4000/month)

- You understand the whole funnel, not just the ad: lead → appointment → sale

- You write copy that sounds like a person, not an ad

- You can create the landing page or instant form

- You make decisions from data, not gut feelings or emotions

- Strong written English.

- You solve problems without needing your hand held



PAY: £100-£200 GBP ($132-$265 USD) per client account, per month, paid at the end of each month.



BONUS POINTS IF:



- You know your way around GoHighLevel.

- You know Meta's ad rules well enough to keep an account out of trouble.

- You've run ads for UK companies before.

- You're organised and you speak up early. If something's going wrong, we hear it from you first.

- You're funny



WHY JOIN US?



We're a small, fast-moving agency in London. We find customers for home improvement companies, like plumbers, roofers, kitchen & bathroom renovators and solar fitters.



We judge a campaign by booked jobs, never by clicks.



We're small enough that good work gets noticed. The better you are, the more you'll own. If you’re exceptional, we won’t make you wait years before you get more responsibility.



You’ll run real campaigns across multiple clients, learn what actually works in home services, and take on more accounts as we grow.



We treat everyone on our team with respect and kindness. We value integrity, persistence, and innovative thinking.



If all you want is the highest hourly rate going, this probably isn't the role for you. If you want true ownership, honest feedback and the chance to become one of the best home service media buyers out there and scale with us, you'll fit right in.



HOW TO APPLY



No CV needed – we want to get to know YOU.



Send us a short video, 3 to 5 minutes long, with:



- A quick introduction and why you want this role

- A bit about you. Personal, casual, funny, whatever comes naturally.

- Your screen in Ads Manager, walking us through one campaign you ran: the goal, the results, what it spent, what each lead cost, and one change that improved it

- A real ad you made, with a breakdown of why it works

- How you would approach the first 30 days working on a new client account in the home service industry



We care more about how you talk and think than how you look on paper. Applications without a video won't be considered. Pre-made videos, generic applications and copy-pasted messages won't be considered either. Your video should cover the five points above, made for this job.



Upload your video to Loom, YouTube or Google Drive, and paste the link in your application. Check that anyone with the link can watch it.

title: Marketing & Admin Virtual Assistant for Events Company in Australia
description:
How to apply — mandatory requirements

Three things are required from every applicant. No exceptions.

- A 3-minute Loom video. Introduce yourself and walk through your experience with admin or coordination work and with social media. Please speak naturally and DO NOT read from a script — we're listening for how you communicate, not how polished you sound.

- An updated CV in PDF format.

- Samples of your Canva work — a portfolio PDF, a link, or three to five graphics you've made for a business. Social media posts, promos, menus or event graphics are all fine.



Applications missing any of these will NOT be considered.



Summary

We're a recruitment partner hiring on behalf of an established Australian company that runs large-scale public food and lifestyle events.



They need one person who can do two things well: keep the admin tight, and keep the marketing moving. That means chasing vendors for paperwork and following through until it's done, and also reaching out to influencers, posting to social, and producing clean graphics in Canva. You won't set strategy or creative direction — you'll be the person who makes sure what's been d
 actually happens, and happens well.



The business owner is hands-on but busy, and doesn't have time to teach. If you're someone who figures things out, asks the right questions once, and then just gets on with it, this is a good fit.



What you'll be doing

- Admin and vendor follow-up — sending contracts and welcome information to 20–25 vendors per event, collecting their documents, tracking who's outstanding, and chasing until everything is closed off. Nobody should have to check whether you followed up.

- Tracking and reporting — keeping the event tracker current, flagging what's overdue, and sending a short end-of-day summary so nothing depends on anyone's memory.

- Influencer and creator outreach — finding local creators who genuinely fit an event, drafting the approach, confirming attendance, chasing content and saving links. Relevance matters more than follower count.

- Social media — scheduling posts, setting up
 Events, keeping bios and pinned content current across Instagram and TikTok.

- Canva graphics — event promos, countdown posts, vendor features, Instagram-ready assets the owner can post without redesigning.

-
 and SMS campaigns — briefing design, scheduling sends, testing links, recording performance.

- Community outreach — researching local businesses, schools, clubs and community pages that could help promote an event, and contacting them.



What we're looking for

- Strong admin and organisation. You follow up relentlessly, politely, and without being asked, and you keep a record of what's been done.

- Comfortable with social media and influencers — you've managed accounts, reached out to creators, or run campaigns for a real business.

- Canva at a solid level. Not just templates — you can produce something a brand would actually post.

- Independent. You can take a loosely defined task, work out what's needed, and deliver it without hand-holding.

- Clear, professional written English — you'll be the main contact for dozens of vendors and creators.

- Comfortable with spreadsheets and task management tools. Experience with Mailchimp, Klaviyo or similar is a bonus.

- Events experience is a plus, not a requirement. Organised marketing or admin work for a small business counts.



Hours

- Events run Friday to Sunday, so some weekend availability is needed during event weeks.

title: Director of Operations — Remote (U.S. Company)
description:
# Director of Operations — Remote | U.S.-Based Company



**Company:** PM Assembly



**Type of Work:** Full-Time



**Work Location:** Remote — Philippines



**Hours per Week:** 45 hours



**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time



**Salary:** $12–$18 USD per hour ($2,080–$3,120 USD per month), depending on experience and qualifications



### About PM Assembly



PM Assembly is a growing U.S.-based company providing professional assembly and installation services nationwide across all 48 continental states.



We work directly with established brands, manufacturers, and customers, coordinating installation projects through our network of professional technicians across the country.



Our services include furniture assembly, saunas, pergolas, outdoor structures, fitness equipment, and other residential and commercial installations.



We're entering an exciting period of expansion and are looking for an experienced Director of Operations to help build the systems, team, and operational structure needed to support our growth.



### About the Role



We're looking for a highly capable, independent, and experienced operations leader to take ownership of our company's day-to-day operations.



This is a hands-on leadership position with significant responsibility and decision-making authority.



You'll work directly with the company owner, initially managing a team of approximately 2–3 account managers while developing the operational processes needed to support a much larger organization.



Our goal is to build a company that operates efficiently, consistently, and independently, with clear accountability across the team.



You'll have the opportunity to play a major role in shaping how the company operates as it grows.



### Key Responsibilities



**1. Daily Operations Management**



- Oversee day-to-day operations and ensure projects are handled accurately and efficiently.

- Manage installation scheduling, project coordination, customer communications, and issue resolution through the account management team.

- Ensure daily priorities are completed and nothing important falls through the cracks.

- Identify operational bottlenecks and implement effective solutions.

- Handle escalated situations that require management-level decisions.



**2. Team Leadership and Management**



- Initially oversee approximately 2–3 account managers, with the responsibility to manage a growing team.

- Establish clear responsibilities, expectations, and performance standards.

- Monitor team productivity, quality of work, and accountability.

- Conduct team meetings, provide feedback, and address performance concerns.

- Create a positive, professional, and results-oriented work environment.



**3. Systems and Process Development**



- Develop and improve standard operating procedures (SOPs).

- Build efficient workflows for scheduling, project tracking, customer communication, and technician coordination.

- Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements.

- Implement systems that allow the company to handle increasing installation volume without sacrificing service quality.

- Ensure procedures are documented, consistently followed, and continuously improved.



**4. Hiring and Team Development**



- Identify staffing needs as the company grows.

- Participate in recruiting, interviewing, selecting, and onboarding new employees.

- Develop training processes that allow new team members to become productive quickly.

- Help establish a management structure that can support future expansion.



**5. Quality Control and Accountability**



- Ensure customers and business partners receive a consistently high level of service.

- Monitor installation progress, scheduling accuracy, and project completion.

- Review operational issues and develop solutions to prevent recurring problems.

- Track important performance indicators and report results to company ownership.

- Take responsibility for ensuring the operation runs smoothly.



**6. Business Growth and Operational Strategy**



- Work directly with the owner to prepare the company for increased installation volume.

- Evaluate operational capacity and determine when additional staff or resources are needed.

- Develop strategies to improve efficiency, scalability, and overall performance.

- Help build an organization capable of operating with minimal day-to-day involvement from the owner.



### Qualifications



- At least 4 years of experience in operations management, team leadership, or a comparable management role.

- Demonstrated experience managing employees and holding teams accountable.

- Experience creating or improving operational processes and workflows.

- Strong organizational, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Ability to communicate professionally with U.S.-based customers, business partners, and team members.

- Experience with project management software, CRM systems, spreadsheets, and business communication tools.

- Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.

- Comfortable making independent decisions and taking responsibility for outcomes.

- Experience recruiting, onboarding, and training employees.



Experience in field services, installation services, logistics, scheduling, dispatch, or service-based businesses is a plus but not required.



### What We're Looking For



We're interested in someone who:



- Takes initiative rather than waiting for instructions.

- Can make decisions independently and knows when escalation is necessary.

- Has strong leadership skills and can manage people effectively.

- Thinks strategically while remaining involved in daily execution.

- Can build systems and processes rather than simply maintain existing ones.

- Is comfortable taking ownership of problems and seeing them through to resolution.

- Can adapt to a growing business where priorities and responsibilities evolve.

- Communicates clearly, professionally, and confidently.



### Compensation and Benefits



- $12–$18 USD per hour, depending on experience.

- Full-time, long-term remote position.

- Paid time off and company holidays in accordance with our company policy.

- Opportunity for compensation reviews based on performance and responsibilities.

- Direct collaboration with company ownership.

- Opportunity to play a significant role in building and scaling a growing U.S. company.



### Work Schedule



Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, with a one-hour unpaid break.



Applicants must be comfortable working this schedule consistently from the Philippines, including the corresponding overnight hours.



### How to Apply



Please submit the following:



**1. Resume or CV**



Include your relevant professional experience, particularly previous operations management and leadership positions.



**2. Loom Introduction Video — Required**

Include a shareable Loom link in your application and ensure the video is accessible.

• Flexible, remote work environment.

• Consistent part-time work (20 hrs/week) with fast track to full-time.

• Opportunity to become a key team member as our GHL White Label program expands.

• Stable pay between $8.00 – $10.00/hr starting pay based on experience. (Additional pay for individual build-outs such as custom websites) & regular pay increases as our business grows

• Work directly with a team passionate about helping small businesses grow using GoHighLevel.

________________________________________

How to Apply

Before we schedule a Zoom interview, please answer the following five questions directly in the OnlineJobs.ph message area.



1. GoHighLevel Experience



How many years have you worked with GoHighLevel? How many business sub-accounts have you personally set up from scratch? Describe the types of businesses you have worked with and which GHL features you are most skilled at using.

A business wants to capture leads from a website form, add them to a CRM pipeline, send an immediate text and

Have you personally built and launched AI chatbots or Voice AI agents inside GoHighLevel?

A client wants a landing page where visitors can watch a video, schedule an appointment, or purchase a monthly subscription.



Explain which parts of GoHighLevel you would use to build this system and how you would test it before delivering it to the client.



5. Troubleshooting and Client Training



A client tells you that leads are entering their CRM, but appointment reminders and follow-up text messages are not being sent.



Walk me through how you would find and fix the problem. Also, explain how you would teach an American business owner to use the system after you fix it.



IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



Our last three applicants were unable to complete basic practical GoHighLevel tasks during their live Zoom interviews, despite claiming to have GHL experience.



I have personally built numerous AI agents, CRM pipelines, workflows, automations, and other systems inside GoHighLevel.

We need someone who can actually BUILD, TEST, FIX, and EXPLAIN GoHighLevel systems.



Please answer all five questions based on your personal hands-on experience. Applicants who demonstrate the required skills will be invited to the next round of interviews.
